title_cn: EvoSherlock：面向视频中未见长尾安全关键事件的智能体式终身演化
abstract_cn: 现有面向安全的视频理解（SVU）系统假设一个「封闭世界」：类别集静态、标签充足，并默认所有事件类型预先已知。真实世界的安全关键事件打破这些假设：它们服从长尾分布，新类型持续涌现，而关键安全事件可能只有极少量样本。我们将这一缺口形式化为视频中长尾安全关键事件的终身演化任务（L²-SCE），这是一个新任务，要求 VLM 在不遗忘已学事件的前提下，从稀缺样本中持续分类并时间定位新出现的安全关键事件。进一步地，L²-SCE 揭示了两个关键挑战：（1）事件内稀缺（Intra-Event Scarcity），极端数据稀缺可能同时削弱对新事件的分类与时间定位；（2）事件间干扰（Inter-Event Interference），跨事件特征纠缠与表征漂移可能加剧灾难性遗忘。在此基础上，我们提出 EvoSherlock，一种由具备自反式闭环控制的智能体控制器（Agentic Controller）端到端编排的因果增强方法，包含两个核心模块：面向事件内稀缺的因果视频生成模块（CVG）与面向事件间干扰的因果解耦与对齐模块（CDA），分别应对上述两个挑战。此外，本文构建了 L²-SCE 数据集以模拟真实世界的增量条件。在我们基准上的大量实验证明了 EvoSherlock 相对多个先进基线的优势。这些结果印证了所提任务的重要性，以及该方法在从稀缺样本中分类与时间定位新出现安全关键事件上的有效性。
summary_cn: 提出 L²-SCE 新任务与 EvoSherlock 方法，用因果视频生成与因果解耦模块应对样本稀缺与事件间干扰，在自建基准上优于多个基线。
objective_summary: 将视频中长尾安全关键事件的持续分类与时间定位形式化为新任务 L²-SCE，指出事件内稀缺与事件间干扰两大挑战，提出由智能体控制器编排、含因果视频生成与因果解耦对齐模块的 EvoSherlock 方法，并构建相应数据集。
evidence_note: 在自建 L²-SCE 基准上与多个先进基线对比并针对两大模块设计；论文被 ACM Multimedia 2026 录用，但摘要未给出具体指标数字，也未提及统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次将安全关键视频事件的长尾终身演化形式化为新任务 L²-SCE，并针对事件内稀缺与事件间干扰分别设计机制，属开辟新问题形式化。
scope: 结论适用于以 VLM 为骨干、类别持续增长且样本稀缺的安全视频事件识别与时间定位；摘要未覆盖开放世界识别以外的场景（如跨摄像头泛化、实时约束）。
limitations: 实验主要在作者自建基准上进行，外部数据集泛化未报告
摘要未给出量化指标与统计检验
新任务依赖自模拟的增量条件，与真实增量流分布的差异未知

title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination
abstract: AI agents for security inspect web pages, source code, logs, configuration files, and command outputs. These environments may contain deceptive artifacts that influence the agent's behavior. We call this adversarial task contamination. Whereas prompt injection relies on attacker-supplied instructions, task contamination also includes non-instructional evidence, such as fake results and decoy endpoints. We present AgentLSD, a controlled framework for studying adversarial task contamination. AgentLSD uses Capture the Flag (CTF) challenges as its experimental environment. We inject trap artifacts, such as fake flags, misleading hints, decoy endpoints, and hidden cues, while preserving the intended CTF solution. The framework supports paired clean and trap-augmented experiments with deterministic trap generation, runtime injection, telemetry, and delivery verification. We evaluate six models on 11 web CTF challenges. In the clean condition, agents capture 41% of the flags, and no model solves every challenge. We then measure the impact of task contamination. Even when the agent still recovers the flag, traps increase the number of turns (+20) and reasoning tokens (+2k). Solve-rate effects are more heterogeneous, as some model-challenge pairs are largely unaffected while others follow decoys or submit wrong flags. These results show that clean CTF performance understates vulnerability to deceptive task evidence. AgentLSD isolates this effect and provides a reproducible benchmark for studying it. We release the framework, configurations, trap specifications, and raw traces.
comment: To be published in the 19th ACM Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISec 2026) co-located with CCS 2026
title_cn: AgentLSD：在对抗性任务污染下评估 AI 安全智能体
abstract_cn: 面向安全的 AI 智能体要检查网页、源码、日志、配置文件与命令输出，这些环境可能包含影响智能体行为的欺骗性工件。我们把这种现象称为对抗性任务污染。与提示注入依赖攻击者提供的指令不同，任务污染还包括非指令性证据，如伪造结果与诱饵端点。我们提出 AgentLSD，一个研究对抗性任务污染的受控框架：以 CTF 挑战为实验环境，注入假旗标、误导提示、诱饵端点与隐藏线索等陷阱工件，同时保留预期 CTF 解法。框架支持成对的干净/加陷阱实验，具确定性陷阱生成、运行时注入、遥测与投递验证。我们在 11 个网页 CTF 挑战上评估六个模型。干净条件下智能体拿下 41% 的旗标，没有模型解出全部挑战。随后我们测量任务污染的影响：即使智能体仍找回旗标，陷阱也使回合数增加（+20）与推理令牌增加（+2k）；解题率效应更异质——部分模型-挑战对基本不受影响，另一些则跟随诱饵或提交错误旗标。结果表明干净 CTF 性能低估了对欺骗性任务证据的易感性。AgentLSD 隔离了这一效应并提供可复现基准。我们发布框架、配置、陷阱规范与原始轨迹。
summary_cn: CTF 基准 AgentLSD 量化「对抗性任务污染」：六模型 11 挑战干净组解题 41%，陷阱即使不阻止夺旗也使回合 +20、推理令牌 +2k，部分模型跟随诱饵提交错旗。
objective_summary: 构建以 CTF 为环境、可确定性注入陷阱工件的受控框架 AgentLSD，成对测量对抗性任务污染对六个安全智能体模型的成本与解题率影响。
evidence_note: 六模型×11 网页 CTF 挑战的成对干净/加陷阱受控实验，含确定性陷阱生成与投递验证；AISec 2026（CCS workshop）录用并发布框架与轨迹；挑战规模有限。
novelty_note: 把「非指令性欺骗证据」从提示注入中分离出来并给出首个受控基准，概念切分与可复现工具为贡献；欺骗性环境对智能体的影响已有零散报告。
scope: 结论适用于网页类 CTF 环境中的安全智能体与所测六模型；对真实生产环境与非 CTF 任务类型的污染效应未验证。
limitations: 11 个挑战的规模对统计结论偏小；效应在模型-挑战对间异质，聚合数字易误读；陷阱类型覆盖有限。

title: Analog Pin Directionality as an Exfiltration Attack Surface in Mixed-Signal ICs
abstract: Mixed-signal SoCs rely on nominally input-only analog pins to acquire off-chip signals, but the directionality of these interfaces is generally treated as a functional property rather than explicitly verified as a security property. This work identifies and experimentally demonstrates a directionality-based class of analog and mixed-signal (AMS) exfiltration attacks in which data-dependent circuit-offset modulation converts a nominally input-only pin into an outbound information channel. We analytically model the attack mechanism and identify three enabling host conditions: a closed-loop amplifier, an exposed amplifier input, and sufficiently high impedance at that pin. This attack class is validated through a representative silicon case study using a photoplethysmography (PPG) analog front-end (AFE) fabricated in a commercial 55-nm CMOS process. The payload incurs $<$0.001\% area overhead relative to typical biosensing AFEs. Under the evaluated conditions, payload activation reduces the filtered PPG-output SNR by only 0.03~dB, while the maximum HT-induced perturbation of 5.9\% of the PPG amplitude remains within the 34.3\% benign variation at the exposed sensor-input pin across process and temperature. The raw exfiltration SINR remains below -20~dB, while targeted filtering increases it above 14~dB and enables signal recovery. Silicon measurements demonstrate data exfiltration through the input pin at bit rates up to 10~kbps and error-free recovery of a PRBS message. These results expose a conventional test-observability gap and establish analog pin directionality as an AMS security property requiring explicit verification, test coverage, and defense rather than being inferred from nominal signal flow.

title_cn: 模拟引脚方向性：混合信号芯片的数据外泄攻击面
abstract_cn: 混合信号 SoC 依赖名义上仅输入的模拟引脚获取片外信号，但这些接口的方向性通常被当作功能属性，而未被显式验证为安全属性。本工作识别并以实验证明一类基于方向性的模拟/混合信号（AMS）数据外泄攻击：数据相关的电路失调调制把名义仅输入的引脚变成外向信息信道。我们解析建模攻击机制并识别三个使能宿主条件：闭环放大器、暴露的放大器输入以及该引脚足够高的阻抗。该攻击类通过商业 55nm CMOS 工艺流片的光电容积脉搏波（PPG）模拟前端（AFE）硅样例验证：载荷相对典型生物传感 AFE 面积开销 <0.001%；受评条件下载荷激活仅使滤波后 PPG 输出 SNR 降低 0.03 dB，而硬件木马引起的最大扰动（PPG 幅度的 5.9%）仍落在暴露传感输入引脚跨工艺与温度的 34.3% 良性变化之内。原始外泄 SINR 低于 -20 dB，而针对性滤波可提升至 14 dB 以上并实现信号恢复。硅测量演示了经输入引脚的数据外泄速率高达 10 kbps 并无误恢复 PRBS 消息。这些结果暴露了一个常规测试可观测性缺口，并把模拟引脚方向性确立为需要显式验证、测试覆盖与防御的 AMS 安全属性，而非从名义信号流推断。
summary_cn: 55nm 硅样例证明「仅输入」模拟引脚可成外泄信道：面积开销 <0.001%、SNR 仅降 0.03 dB 隐蔽生效，滤波后 10 kbps 无误恢复 PRBS。
objective_summary: 识别并以解析模型刻画经名义仅输入模拟引脚的 AMS 外泄攻击类，给出三个使能宿主条件，并在 55nm CMOS 流片的 PPG 模拟前端硅样例上验证。
evidence_note: 商业 55nm 工艺流片的真实硅测量：10 kbps 外泄、PRBS 无误恢复、面积/SNR/SINR 全部量化并给出三条件使能模型；投稿 TIFS 在审。
novelty_note: 首次把模拟引脚方向性确立为 AMS 安全属性并系统化一类外泄攻击（机制模型+使能条件+硅验证），开辟混合信号芯片的新攻击面。
scope: 结论适用于满足三使能条件（闭环放大器、暴露输入、高阻抗）的混合信号 SoC 模拟前端；对纯数字接口与无闭环放大器设计不适用。
limitations: 验证限于单一 PPG AFE 硅案例；针对性滤波恢复依赖对信号特征的先验；对温度/工艺角全空间的鲁棒性未穷尽。

title: Characterizing Network Centralization and Observability in the Remote MCP Ecosystem
abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as the dominant interface for connecting autonomous agents to external data sources and execution environments. The ecosystem's transition from local process execution to remote Streamable HTTP deployments introduces unmeasured architectural and security constraints at scale. This paper presents a three-tier observability framework comprising catalog metadata (O_0), passive compliance signals (O_1), and live vulnerability analysis (O_2), applied to empirically characterize the public MCP server ecosystem. Evaluation of a stratified sample of 179 remote endpoints across two primary public registries reveals significant infrastructural consolidation. The Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) computed over the Autonomous System Number (ASN) distribution yields a value of 0.736, well above the 0.25 threshold for a highly concentrated market. Analysis further indicates that server authentication is strongly correlated with hosting platform choice rather than individual operator configuration, with 95\% of commercial PaaS-hosted servers enforcing gateway-level OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. The empirical results identify a Security-Observability Tradeoff observed in the current ecosystem: the platform-level authentication mechanisms that secure the majority of servers simultaneously limit automated vulnerability scanning capabilities, constraining the ability of AI gateway operators to assess tool-poisoning vectors without prior credential provisioning.

title_cn: 刻画远程 MCP 生态的网络集中度与可观测性
abstract_cn: 模型上下文协议（MCP）已成为连接自主智能体与外部数据源及执行环境的主导接口。该生态从本地进程执行向远程 Streamable HTTP 部署的转变，引入了规模化下未测量的架构与安全约束。本文提出三层可观测性框架——目录元数据（O_0）、被动合规信号（O_1）与在线漏洞分析（O_2）——并据此实证刻画公开 MCP 服务器生态。对来自两个主要公共注册表的 179 个远程端点分层样本的评估显示显著的基础设施集中化：基于自治系统号（ASN）分布计算的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）为 0.736，远高于高集中市场的 0.25 阈值。分析还表明服务器认证与托管平台选择强相关而非与运营者个体配置相关：95% 的商业 PaaS 托管服务器强制执行带 PKCE 的网关级 OAuth 2.1。实证结果识别出当前生态的「安全-可观测性权衡」：保障多数服务器的平台级认证机制同时限制了自动化漏洞扫描能力，使 AI 网关运营者在没有预先凭证的情况下难以评估工具投毒向量。
summary_cn: 对 179 个远程 MCP 端点的三层测量：ASN 集中度 HHI 0.736（远超 0.25 高集中阈值），95% PaaS 服务器经平台强制 OAuth 2.1，揭示安全与扫描可观测性的权衡。
objective_summary: 提出目录/被动/主动三层可观测性框架，对两个注册表 179 个远程 MCP 端点做分层测量，量化基础设施集中度、认证格局与安全-可观测性权衡。
evidence_note: 两注册表 179 端点分层样本+三层（目录/被动/主动）测量方法，HHI 与认证比例定量；样本量中等、主动扫描受未认证限制。
novelty_note: 对远程 MCP 生态安全态势的首批系统测量之一，集中化-可观测性权衡的实证刻画具时效价值；测量框架本身为常规组合。
scope: 结论适用于测量时点的两大公共注册表样本与 Streamable HTTP 部署；对私有注册表与本地 MCP 部署不适用。
limitations: 179 端点样本对快速增长的生态代表性有限；未认证端点的漏洞分析深度受限；时间点快照，生态演变快。

title: When Agents Look Like Beacons: NIDS Evasion by Model Context Protocol Traffic
abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes communication between autonomous Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents and remote tools over Streamable HTTP. This shift introduces a class of machine-generated, authenticated, and high-frequency JSON-RPC traffic directly into enterprise networks. Enterprise network defenders have historically relied on machine-like cadence as an Indicator of Compromise (IoC). In this study, we show that without explicit network-layer indication, MCP traffic structurally and temporally resembles Command and Control (C2) beaconing behavior, specifically the polling architectures used by advanced persistent threats like Cobalt Strike. Counter to theoretical assumptions about machine-generated polling, our measurements reveal a visibility gap: standard enterprise Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and behavioral beacon-scoring frameworks do not classify MCP remote tool usage as anomalous within our testbed scope. Through a controlled Docker-based testbed simulating eleven mathematically defined traffic profiles across three TLS conditions (Opaque, TLS-Inspected, and Cleartext), we evaluate Suricata signature matching and RITA behavioral scoring against MCP JSON-RPC patterns. Our results show that MCP traffic, regardless of temporal smearing (jitter) or TLS inspection visibility, evades detection within this configuration, yielding a consistent 0.0 behavioral beacon score and near-zero IDS content alerts under the Emerging Threats (ET) Open ruleset. While opaque TLS obscures HTTP content, it exposes agent traffic to flow-level temporal analysis; however, NIDS heuristics tuned to identify traditional malware do not flag the lognormal inter-arrival distributions characteristic of generative AI reasoning loops. To address this gap, we propose an agent-native network indication standard including Agent-Native ALPN and standardized out-of-band headers.

title_cn: 当智能体像信标：模型上下文协议流量的 NIDS 规避
abstract_cn: 模型上下文协议（MCP）把自主 AI 智能体与远程工具间的通信标准化为基于 Streamable HTTP 的交互。这一转变把一类机器生成、已认证、高频的 JSON-RPC 流量直接引入企业网络。企业网络防守者历来把「机器式节律」当作失陷指标（IoC）。本研究显示：在没有显式网络层标识的情况下，MCP 流量在结构与时间上都很像 C2 信标行为——具体是 Cobalt Strike 等高级持续性威胁使用的轮询架构。与「机器生成轮询易于区分」的理论假设相反，我们的测量揭示一个可见性缺口：在受测范围内，标准企业入侵检测系统（IDS）与行为信标评分框架并不把 MCP 远程工具使用归类为异常。通过一个模拟 11 个数学定义流量剖面、跨三种 TLS 条件（不透明、TLS 可检视、明文）的受控 Docker 测试台，我们用 Suricata 签名匹配与 RITA 行为评分评估 MCP JSON-RPC 模式。结果显示：无论时间抖动或 TLS 检视可见性如何，MCP 流量在该配置下均能规避检测——行为信标得分恒为 0.0，在 Emerging Threats（ET）开放规则集下 IDS 内容告警接近零。不透明 TLS 遮蔽 HTTP 内容，却让智能体流量暴露于流级时间分析；但为识别传统恶意软件调校的 NIDS 启发式并不标记生成式 AI 推理回路特有的对数正态到达间隔分布。为填补该缺口，我们提出智能体原生网络标识标准，包括智能体原生 ALPN 与标准化的带外标头。
summary_cn: MCP 流量结构与时序酷似 C2 信标：测试台 11 流量剖面×3 种 TLS 条件下 Suricata 告警近零、RITA 信标得分恒为 0.0，提出 Agent-Native ALPN 等标识标准。
objective_summary: 测量 MCP 流量与 C2 信标的结构/时序相似性，在受控 Docker 测试台上检验 Suricata 与 RITA 的检测表现，并提出智能体原生的网络标识标准。
evidence_note: 受控 Docker 测试台上 11 个流量剖面×3 种 TLS 条件×两套检测工具（Suricata/RITA）的系统测量；自建环境、无在野企业流量验证。
novelty_note: 首次指出 MCP 标准化流量与 C2 信标的结构性混淆并量化 IDS 生态的可见性缺口，问题定位新；测量方法为常规流量分析。
scope: 结论适用于 Streamable HTTP 的 MCP 远程工具部署与受测 IDS/评分器配置；对深度学习 NIDS 与 Agent 标识方案普及后的场景未评估。
limitations: 测试台为自建、11 个剖面数学化定义，真实企业环境多样性未覆盖；仅评估 ET 开放规则集；提议标准尚无实现与采纳验证。

title: Securing quantum error correction against misleading advice from AI agents
abstract: Can an attacker turn influence over an artificial intelligence (AI) adviser into a harmful quantum error-correction update? We identify an ambiguity in passive syndrome records that obstructs recovery selection, then show how additional calibration measurements support certified recovery updates under uncertainty and drift. In an odd-distance square toric code with error-free preparation, syndrome measurements, and recovery operations, opposite coherent $X$ rotations produce identical passive syndrome-history distributions. Yet a fixed phase correction can help at one sign and harm at the other. A terminal logical measurement on known encoded calibration states supplies the missing sign information. A separate evaluator accepts an update only when calibration uncertainty and a justified drift bound certify improvement over the current recovery, without assuming that the adviser recommends correctly. In simulated advice attacks, calibration-confidence checks reject harmful proposals while retaining beneficial updates under honest advice. We derive sufficient limits on calibration age that require improvement through deployment. In matched simulations, a validated channel-specific bound retains more beneficial updates than the general bound after accounting for evaluation time, while preventing the tested harmful activations under the stated drift assumption. A separate surface-code experiment includes stochastic circuit faults and noise changing during acquisition. Deterministic controllers achieve at least as many beneficial updates with the same observations. Violating the drift assumption permits harmful acceptance in the toric experiment. The results identify information required for recovery selection, establish conditional guarantees against harmful updates, and quantify the recovery improvements forgone through conservative acceptance.

title_cn: 保护量子纠错免受 AI 智能体误导性建议的侵害
abstract_cn: 攻击者能否把对 AI 顾问的影响转化为有害的量子纠错更新？我们指出被动综合征记录中存在阻碍恢复选择的歧义，然后展示额外的校准测量如何在不确定性与漂移下支持经认证的恢复更新。在一个具有无错制备、综合征测量与恢复操作的奇距离正方形环面码中，相反方向的相干 X 旋转产生相同的被动综合征历史分布，而固定的相位校正在一个符号下有益、在另一符号下有害。对已知编码校准态的终端逻辑测量提供缺失的符号信息。一个独立评估器仅当校准不确定性与有依据的漂移界证明更新优于当前恢复时才接受更新，而不假设顾问推荐正确。在模拟建议攻击中，校准置信度检查拒绝有害提案，同时在诚实建议下保留有益更新。我们推导校准年龄的充分界限，要求通过部署持续改进。在匹配模拟中，经验证的信道专用界限在计入评估时间后仍比通用界限保留更多有益更新，并在所述漂移假设下阻止被测有害激活。另一个含随机电路故障与采集中噪声变化的表面码实验表明：确定性控制器在相同观测下取得至少同样多的有益更新。漂移假设被违反时，环面实验允许有害接受。结果识别了恢复选择所需信息，建立针对有害更新的条件性保证，并量化保守接受所放弃的恢复改进。
summary_cn: 针对「AI 顾问被操纵」的量子纠错场景：以校准测量+独立评估器给出条件认证更新机制，模拟中拒绝有害建议、保留有益更新，并量化保守接受的机会成本。
objective_summary: 识别被动综合征记录中的歧义，提出以校准测量与独立评估器认证量子纠错恢复更新的机制，在环面码/表面码模拟中评估对建议攻击的抵御与代价。
evidence_note: 环面码与含电路故障/噪声漂移的表面码两类模拟，含匹配对照与失效条件（漂移假设违反即有害接受）；全部为仿真，无硬件实验。
novelty_note: 开辟「对抗性 AI 建议污染量子纠错更新」的新威胁模型，并给出不假设顾问正确的认证接受机制；QEC 与 AI 安全的交叉此前少见。
scope: 结论适用于带校准测量能力与可界定漂移上界的 QEC 设置（环面码/表面码模拟）；对实时性极强、无校准窗口的系统不适用。
limitations: 全部结论来自模拟且依赖漂移假设成立；保守接受放弃的改进幅度在特定参数下可能显著；单作者单设置，外部复现待验证。

title: Structural Decomposability of Encrypted Traffic Side-Channel Leakage
abstract: Existing side-channel theories treat leakage as a holistic quantity $I(X;Y)$, without characterizing its internal structure. This paper studies the \emph{structural decomposability} of encrypted-traffic side-channel leakage. Via the structural causal model $X\!\to\!Y_{\mathrm{size}}\!\to\!Y_{\mathrm{dir}}\!\to\!Y_{\mathrm{time}}$ and the mutual-information chain rule, total leakage is decomposed into three sequential increments for packet size, direction, and timing. Defenses are formalized as mechanism replacement by a strategy variable~$D$; coupling information $C_{\mathrm{size,dir}}=I(Y_{\mathrm{size}};Y_{\mathrm{dir}}\!\mid\!X)$ measures inter-dimensional dependence, and the Markov residual gives a testable condition for a single-dimension defense to sever downstream leakage. Causal efficacy~$\eta_d$ quantifies per-unit-cost suppression, and a Fisher-geometric approximation $I(X;Y)\approx\frac{1}{2\ln 2}\mathrm{Tr}(G\Sigma_\theta)$ holds under small perturbations. On the Wang dataset (95 websites), $Y_{\mathrm{dir}}$ dominates undefended leakage (0.637\,bits), while Tor's fixed 512-byte cells make $Y_{\mathrm{size}}$ degenerate; FRONT suppresses the direction term by 63\%, yet its Markov residual of 0.021\,bits (95\% CI $[0.016,0.027]$) shows it cannot sever timing leakage; $\eta_{\mathrm{dir}}=0.97$ vs. $\eta_{\mathrm{time}}\approx 0$ confirms FRONT's design intent. This yields a computable, structured leakage-accounting method for multi-dimensional joint defense design.
title_cn: 加密流量侧信道泄漏的结构可分解性
abstract_cn: 既有侧信道理论把泄漏当作整体量 I(X;Y) 处理，未刻画其内部结构。本文研究加密流量侧信道泄漏的结构可分解性。借助结构因果模型 X→Y_size→Y_dir→Y_time 与互信息链式法则，总泄漏被分解为包大小、方向与时序三个顺序增量。防御被形式化为以策略变量 D 做机制替换；耦合信息 C_size,dir=I(Y_size;Y_dir|X) 度量维度间依赖，马尔可夫残差给出单维防御能否切断下游泄漏的可检验条件。因果效力 η_d 量化单位成本抑制，并在小扰动下成立 Fisher-几何近似 I(X;Y)≈Tr(GΣ_θ)/(2ln2)。在 Wang 数据集（95 个网站）上，Y_dir 主导未防御泄漏（0.637 比特），而 Tor 的固定 512 字节单元使 Y_size 退化；FRONT 把方向项抑制 63%，但其 0.021 比特的马尔可夫残差（95% CI [0.016,0.027]）表明它无法切断时序泄漏；η_dir=0.97 对 η_time≈0 证实 FRONT 的设计意图。这产出一种可计算、结构化的泄漏记账方法，服务多维联合防御设计。
summary_cn: 把加密流量侧信道泄漏按大小/方向/时序因果分解并给出防御可检验条件：Wang 集上方向项主导（0.637 比特），FRONT 抑制方向 63% 但时序泄漏未被切断。
objective_summary: 以结构因果模型与互信息链式法则把加密流量侧信道泄漏分解为大小/方向/时序增量，定义防御的可检验条件并在 Wang 数据集上分析 Tor 与 FRONT。
evidence_note: 标准 Wang 数据集（95 网站）+对 Tor/FRONT 的定量防御分析并报告 95% 置信区间；数据集规模有限，Fisher-几何近似有适用条件。
novelty_note: 把泄漏从整体量分解为有序增量并给出「马尔可夫残差」可检验条件，是防御设计的新分析透镜；因果模型与互信息链式法则为标准工具。
scope: 结论适用于可按大小/方向/时序观测的加密流量与所测防御（Tor、FRONT）；对填充/突发类新防御与多流聚合场景未验证。
limitations: 单一数据集 95 站点；分解顺序（大小→方向→时序）为建模选择；Fisher-几何近似仅在小扰动下成立。

title: Context-Aware Operational Security for Autonomous Drones
abstract: Autonomous drone-based services have been gaining significant interest across various application domains due to their mobility, flexibility, cost-effectiveness, and capability to integrate various sensors and actuators. However, operational failures or cyberattacks targeting drone systems can lead to severe economic impacts and safety concerns. Hence, ensuring secure and reliable autonomous drone operations is essential for the safe deployment of drone-enabled services. Nevertheless, the traditional security measures fall short due to drones' limited computational resources and power budget (battery), as well as the temporal and sequential behavior of drone operations due to drones' mobile nature. In this paper, we address this gap by utilizing Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), specifically focusing on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, for autonomous drone operation security and reliability due to their temporal and sequential analysis capabilities. We leverage these capabilities for anomaly detection in autonomous drone sensor data and operation commands, which we refer to as Denial of Usage Detection Engine IDS (DUDE-IDS). We integrated the proposed DUDE-IDS into the drone mission computer (i.e., operating directly on drones rather than an edge node or ground control stations) to monitor data flows and to detect potential threats in real-time. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach in identifying anomalies associated with GPS spoofing, Man-in-the-Middle (MITM), replay, and Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks with 98% accuracy. We also evaluate our resource utilization and power consumption under different configurations, demonstrating the applicability of our approach in active drone operations in real-time.
title_cn: 自主无人机情境感知的运行安全
abstract_cn: 自主无人机服务因其移动性、灵活性、成本效益以及集成各类传感器与执行器的能力，在众多应用领域日益受到关注。但针对无人机系统的运营故障或网络攻击会造成严重经济影响与安全顾虑，保障自主无人机运行安全可靠至关重要。然而，由于无人机算力与电池预算有限、且其移动特性带来时序与顺序行为，传统安全措施力不从心。本文利用循环神经网络（RNN）、尤其是长短期记忆（LSTM）网络在时序与顺序分析上的能力，保障自主无人机运行的安全与可靠：对无人机传感器数据与操作指令做异常检测，我们称之为使用拒绝检测引擎 IDS（DUDE-IDS）。我们把 DUDE-IDS 集成进无人机任务计算机（直接在无人机上而非边缘节点或地面站运行），实时监测数据流并检测潜在威胁。大量实验结果表明，该方法在识别 GPS 欺骗、中间人（MITM）、重放与拒绝服务（DoS）攻击相关异常上达到 98% 准确率；我们还在不同配置下评估资源利用与功耗，证明其在活跃无人机实时运行中的适用性。
summary_cn: 机载 LSTM 异常检测 DUDE-IDS：任务计算机上实时监测传感器与指令流，对 GPS 欺骗/MITM/重放/DoS 达 98% 准确率，并评估功耗与资源占用。
objective_summary: 构建面向无人机的 LSTM 异常检测系统 DUDE-IDS 并集成进任务计算机做实时监测，对四类攻击做检测评估与资源/功耗评估。
evidence_note: 单一无人机平台上的原型集成与多攻击类型演示（98% 准确率），但数据集来源、攻击样本量与统计检验未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: LSTM 异常检测用于 IDS 为成熟路线，无人机 IDS 亦有先行工作；增量在任务计算机机载集成与资源约束评估。
scope: 结论适用于所测无人机平台与四类攻击（GPS 欺骗/MITM/重放/DoS）的试验数据；对新型攻击与编队场景未覆盖。
limitations: 98% 准确率的评估协议与数据分布未详述；机载功耗与实时性随模型规模的变化未给全；误报率的运营影响未讨论。

title: BadQubits: An LLM-Based Framework for Static Pre-Execution Detection of Structurally Harmful Quantum Circuits
abstract: This paper presents BadQubits, an LLM-based framework for static pre-execution detection of structurally harmful OpenQASM 2.0 circuits. The framework targets physical-execution-layer threats by analyzing submitted circuits prior to runtime, where dynamic inspection is constrained by measurement irreversibility and the exponential cost of classical quantum-state simulation. We evaluate four code-understanding LLM architectures on a dataset of 1,500 circuits consisting of 1,000 benign programs from MQTBench[33] and 500 synthetic attack circuits derived from three documented physical-layer threat primitives. Our fine-tuned Qwen Coder 2.5 7B model achieves 92.67% classification accuracy and 96.1% harmful-circuit recall. Two of the four evaluated base models fail to generalize under constrained LoRA fine-tuning, indicating that architecture-aware model selection is a necessary design consideration rather than a minor tuning choice. To characterize what the detector has learned, we compare it against a bag-of-gates CNN under progressive confound removal and adversarial syntactic perturbation. The CNN's harmful-circuit recall drops from 100% to 17%, while the fine-tuned LLM decreases only from 96.1% to 91.2%. We attribute this gap to the sequential structure retained in token-level LLM inputs but discarded by histogram-based baselines. A correlation analysis further shows that model decisions track threat-defining features, specifically SWAP density and measurement timing, rather than generator-specific artifacts such as register naming.
title_cn: BadQubits：基于 LLM 的结构有害量子电路执行前静态检测框架
abstract_cn: 本文提出 BadQubits，一个基于 LLM 的框架，用于在执行前静态检测结构上有害的 OpenQASM 2.0 电路。该框架针对物理执行层威胁，在运行时之前分析提交的电路——彼时动态检查受测量不可逆性与经典量子态模拟的指数成本约束。我们在由 1,000 个来自 MQTBench 的良性程序与 500 个从三种有据可查的物理层威胁原语衍生的合成攻击电路组成、共 1,500 个电路的数据集上评估四种代码理解 LLM 架构。我们微调的 Qwen Coder 2.5 7B 模型达到 92.67% 分类准确率与 96.1% 有害电路召回率。四个受评基座模型中有两个在受限 LoRA 微调下无法泛化，说明架构感知的模型选择是必要设计考量而非次要调参选择。为刻画检测器学到什么，我们将其与词袋门 CNN 在渐进混淆移除与对抗句法扰动下比较：CNN 的有害召回从 100% 跌至 17%，而微调 LLM 仅从 96.1% 降至 91.2%。我们把这一差距归因于令牌级 LLM 输入保留、而直方图基线丢弃的序列结构。相关分析进一步表明模型决策追踪威胁定义特征——具体是 SWAP 密度与测量时序——而非寄存器命名等生成器专属伪迹。
summary_cn: LLM 静态检测有害量子电路 BadQubits：微调 Qwen Coder 2.5 7B 在 1,500 电路集上 92.67% 准确/96.1% 召回，对抗扰动下召回仅降 5pp 而 CNN 基线跌至 17%。
objective_summary: 构建基于微调代码 LLM 的量子电路执行前静态检测框架 BadQubits，在 1,500 电路数据集上做多架构对比、混淆移除与对抗扰动消融及决策特征分析。
evidence_note: 1,500 电路数据集（攻击电路为合成）上的多架构对比+渐进混淆移除与对抗扰动消融+决策特征相关分析；无在野部署与统计检验。
novelty_note: 量子云「执行前筛查」场景与 LLM 代码理解组件的组合为新；检测方法学（微调+混淆消融）承袭代码安全检测传统。
scope: 结论适用于 OpenQASM 2.0 结构级威胁与所测四架构 LLM；对运行时才显现的威胁、跨语言中间表示与量子硬件侧信道未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击电路由三种已文档原语合成，对未知威胁型泛化未知；500 个攻击样本规模有限；云服务商部署成本与延迟未评估。

title: Fluid Notarization: Verifiable Evolution of Concurrently Edited Structured Documents
abstract: Traditional blockchain-based document notarization follows a snapshot-oriented model in which each document revision is represented as an independent state anchored on-chain through a cryptographic reference. While effective for immutable artifacts, this approach becomes inadequate when documents evolve through collaborative editing. Concurrent modifications create divergent document versions that must be reconciled outside the notarization layer, while even minor changes require generating and distributing new document snapshots. Conversely, collaborative replication frameworks such as CRDTs provide deterministic reconciliation of concurrent updates, but do not inherently provide independently verifiable evidence of when contributions were published. This paper introduces Fluid Notarization, a notarization paradigm in which document evolution itself becomes the object of notarization. Rather than certifying isolated states, Fluid Notarization certifies a graph of causally related evolution artifacts generated by a JSON-native delta-CRDT. The proposed model builds upon Melda, which represents document changes as compact, content-addressed deltas linked through causal dependencies. Blockchain notarization is reduced to recording identifiers of these evolution artifacts, while synchronization, reconstruction, and conflict resolution remain entirely off-chain. The resulting architecture combines two complementary guarantees: deterministic convergence provided by the CRDT and independently auditable proof-of-existence, provenance, and publication evidence provided by the blockchain. A prototype implementation and validation scenario based on collaboratively edited electronic health records demonstrate the feasibility of the approach and highlight the advantages of notarizing document evolution rather than successive document snapshots.
title_cn: 流体公证：并发编辑结构化文档的可验证演化
abstract_cn: 传统基于区块链的文档公证遵循快照导向模型：每个文档修订版本作为独立状态经密码学引用锚定上链。这对不可变工件有效，但对经由协作编辑演化的文档则力不从心：并发修改产生必须在公证层之外调和的分叉版本，而即使微小更改也需要生成并分发新的文档快照。相反，协作复制框架（如 CRDT）提供并发更新的确定性调和，却不天然提供贡献何时发布的独立可验证证据。本文提出流体公证（Fluid Notarization）：让文档演化本身成为公证对象。它不再认证孤立状态，而是认证由 JSON 原生 delta-CRDT 生成的因果关联演化工件图。该模型构建于 Melda 之上——把文档变更表示为经因果依赖链接的紧凑内容寻址增量；区块链公证被简化为记录这些演化工件的标识符，而同步、重建与冲突解决完全留在链下。由此架构结合两种互补保证：CRDT 提供的确定性收敛，与区块链提供的独立可审计的存在性、溯源与发布证据。基于协作编辑电子健康记录的原型实现与验证场景展示了该方法的可行性，并凸显公证文档演化而非相继快照的优势。
summary_cn: 提出「流体公证」：以 delta-CRDT 因果演化工件图替代快照上链，链上只记标识符、链下完成同步与调和，电子健康记录原型验证可行性。
objective_summary: 提出以 delta-CRDT 演化工件图为公证对象的流体公证范式，链上仅记录工件标识符、链下保留同步与调和，并用电子健康记录原型验证可行性。
evidence_note: 原型实现+单一电子健康记录验证场景，展示可行性；无性能基准、安全分析与对抗评估的定量报告。
novelty_note: 把公证对象从「状态快照」转向「演化图」是范式级新视角；delta-CRDT 与 Melda 内容寻址结构为既有组件。
scope: 结论适用于 JSON 结构化文档的协作编辑公证场景；对二进制文档、高吞吐公证与链上信任假设变化的场景未评估。
limitations: 仅一个 EHR 验证场景；链下组件（Melda）的可用性与密钥管理影响公证有效性；性能与成本未量化。

title: Low-Rank Masking for Single-Server Matrix Multiplication
abstract: We study the statistical privacy of outsourcing matrix multiplication over a finite field ${\mathbb F_q}$ to a single server using additive masks of rank at most $r$. For independent uniform $n\times n$ inputs, we show that uniform \emph{rank-ball masks} and products of independent uniform factors give maximal-correlation secrecy of at most $q^{-r}$ against the complete server view, with $O(n^2r)$ field operations for encoding and decoding. This secrecy captures how effectively the server is prevented from estimating functions of the inputs. We prove an asymptotically matching lower bound of this secrecy measure for $r=o(n)$, showing that both sampling methods are asymptotically optimal among input-independent additive masks of rank at most $r$, even when secret invertible transformations are allowed. We also characterize the posterior distribution for uniform rank-ball masks under arbitrary joint input distributions and prove approximate individual security for rows and columns under independent uniform inputs. Finally, we show that every input-independent additive mask of rank at most $r=o(n)$ requires $\delta\to1$ in entry-level $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-differential privacy for fixed field size $q$ and bounded $\varepsilon$.
title_cn: 单服务器矩阵乘法的低秩掩码
abstract_cn: 我们研究把有限域 F_q 上的矩阵乘法外包给单台服务器时、秩至多 r 的加法掩码的统计隐私。对独立均匀的 n×n 输入，我们证明均匀秩球掩码与独立均匀因子乘积对服务器完整视图的最大相关保密至多为 q^(-r)，编解码仅需 O(n²r) 次域运算。该保密度量刻画服务器估计输入函数被阻止的程度。我们证明对 r=o(n) 该保密度的渐近匹配下界，表明两种采样方法在秩至多 r 的输入无关加法掩码中渐近最优——即使允许秘密可逆变换。我们还刻画均匀秩球掩码在任意联合输入分布下的后验分布，并证明独立均匀输入下行与列的近似个体安全性。最后我们证明：对固定域大小 q 与有界 ε，每个秩至多 r=o(n) 的输入无关加法掩码在条目级 (ε,δ)-差分隐私下都要求 δ→1。
summary_cn: 证明单服务器矩阵乘法低秩加法掩码的最大相关保密上界 q^(-r) 并给出匹配下界（渐近最优），进一步证明此类掩码无法提供非平凡差分隐私（δ→1）。
objective_summary: 刻画有限域上低秩加法掩码的最大相关保密上界并证明渐近匹配下界，附加后验分布刻画与该类掩码不满足非平凡差分隐私的不可能性结果。
evidence_note: 上界与渐近匹配下界完整，附后验分布刻画与 DP 不可能性结果，理论链条闭合；无实验（理论工作属性）。
novelty_note: 对低秩加法掩码给出首个渐近紧的保密刻画并揭示其与 DP 的不兼容，属实质理论贡献；最大相关保密度量为已有工具。
scope: 结论适用于有限域上秩至多 r=o(n) 的输入无关加法掩码与独立均匀输入模型；对自适应掩码、多服务器与结构化输入未覆盖。
limitations: 渐近结果（r=o(n)）对中小秩常数情形的紧性未定；单服务器威胁模型；未给出实际系统参数建议。

title: Hamming Ideals and Grobner Bases for ISD-like Syndrome Decoding
abstract: We investigate an algebraic approach to the Syndrome Decoding Problem, based on a reformulation of the Hamming weight constraint and its integration with the Information Set Decoding paradigm. We begin with a systematic analysis of the Hamming variety, deriving its defining equations in terms of elementary symmetric functions. Since these equations may have high degree, we exploit convolution identities for elementary symmetric functions, together with factorizations based on Lucas' identity, to derive an equivalent formulation with auxiliary variables and equations of bounded degree. Building on this modeling, we generalize the ISD paradigm through an ISD-like decoding strategy, implemented by the GBDecode algorithm, in which only a subset of an information set is fixed. This approach reduces the size of the combinatorial search space at the cost of solving the associated multivariate nonlinear systems. To handle this algebraic component, we employ the MultiSolve algorithm, which replaces a single Grobner basis computation with a collection of computations on simpler systems, obtained by exhaustively assigning a varying number of indeterminates over the finite field. This provides a tunable balance between combinatorial search and algebraic solving. We evaluate the resulting approach experimentally on instances of the Syndrome Decoding Problem for random binary linear codes, using parameters corresponding to the NIST Security Category 1 parameter set of the Classic McEliece cryptosystem. The experiments assess the feasibility of this combinatorial-algebraic approach and provide insights into the practical behavior of Grobner basis techniques within an ISD-like decoding framework.
comment: 29 pages
title_cn: 汉明理想与 Gröbner 基：ISD 式综合征解码的代数途径
abstract_cn: 我们研究综合征解码问题的一种代数途径：重构汉明重量约束并将其与信息集解码（ISD）范式结合。我们从汉明簇的系统分析开始，用初等对称函数导出其定义方程；由于这些方程次数可能很高，我们利用初等对称函数的卷积恒等式与基于 Lucas 恒等式的因式分解，推导出带辅助变量、方程次数有界的等价表述。在此建模之上，我们通过 GBDecode 算法把 ISD 范式推广为一种 ISD 式解码策略——只固定信息集的一个子集——以解多元非线性系统为代价缩减组合搜索空间。为处理该代数成分，我们采用 MultiSolve 算法：把单次 Gröbner 基计算替换为对更简单系统的一组计算，这些系统由在有限域上穷举指派数量不定的变元得到，在组合搜索与代数求解间提供可调平衡。我们在与 Classic McEliece 密码系统 NIST 安全类别 1 参数对应的随机二元线性码实例上实验评估该途径，评估这种组合-代数方法的可行性，并为 Gröbner 基技术在 ISD 式解码框架内的实际行为提供洞见。
summary_cn: 以汉明簇+Lucas 恒等式重构综合征解码的代数途径：GBDecode 部分固定信息集+MultiSolve 分解 Gröbner 计算，在 Classic McEliece NIST 类别 1 参数上评估可行性。
objective_summary: 重构汉明重量约束的代数表述并提出部分固定信息集的 ISD 式解码算法 GBDecode 与分治 Gröbner 计算 MultiSolve，在 Classic McEliece NIST 类别 1 参数上评估可行性。
evidence_note: 在 NIST 类别 1 真实参数上做实验评估并报告可行性洞见；未声称攻破，也无与最优 ISD 变体的复杂度/运行时间系统对比。
novelty_note: 重量约束的代数重构与「部分信息集+分治 Gröbner」的可调平衡是综合征解码代数分析中的新组合；ISD 范式与 Gröbner 基技术均成熟。
scope: 结论适用于随机二元线性码与 Classic McEliece 类参数的代数分析；对结构化码（LDPC/MDPC）与其他后量子族未覆盖。
limitations: 未取得对既有 ISD 复杂度的改进；穷举指派的组合成本仍高；仅二元码上的初步可行性。

title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions
abstract: Privacy evaluations of tool-using LLM agents often inspect a designated action, final response, or attacker report. These local proxies can miss unauthorized exposure elsewhere in a multi-step session and lack common ground truth across outlets, reports, and tool paths. We introduce privacy exposure displacement, the mismatch between a local evaluation proxy and target-grounded session exposure, and ASLEval, an authorization-aware framework that pre-registers a hidden target set, measures all declared visible exits, and reserves internal traces for diagnosis. Across multiple enterprise-style environments and independently implemented runtimes, we observe three recurring patterns. An expected-outlet-only view misses 46.9% of exposure recovered by the visible-exit union; attacker self-reports combine omissions with high false discovery; and schema-aligned internal evidence usually precedes visible exposure at the request/probe level. Reducing model-visible returns changes this path but can eliminate normal-task success. Independent human review supports the adjudication pipeline while identifying harder console and candidate cases. These findings motivate benchmarks that declare the complete visible boundary, ground claims in pre-specified targets and authorization, and report privacy together with task utility.
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures; includes appendix
title_cn: ASLEval：度量 LLM 智能体会话中的隐私暴露位移
abstract_cn: 对工具使用型 LLM 智能体的隐私评估通常检查指定动作、最终回复或攻击者报告。这些局部代理可能漏掉多步会话中其他地方的未授权暴露，且在各出口、报告与工具路径之间缺乏共同地面真值。我们提出「隐私暴露位移」——局部评估代理与以目标为锚的会话暴露之间的错位——以及 ASLEval：一个授权感知的框架，预注册隐藏目标集、测量所有声明的可见出口，并把内部轨迹保留用于诊断。跨多个企业风格环境与独立实现的运行时，我们观察到三种反复出现的模式：仅看预期出口的视角会漏掉可见出口并集所回收暴露的 46.9%；攻击者自我报告同时存在遗漏与高假发现率；模式对齐的内部证据通常在请求/探测层面先于可见暴露出现。减少模型可见返回会改变这条路径，但可能消除正常任务成功。独立人工评审支持裁决流水线，同时指出更难的控制台与候选案例。这些发现促使基准应声明完整可见边界、以预指定目标与授权锚定主张，并连同任务效用一起报告隐私。
summary_cn: 提出「隐私暴露位移」与 ASLEval 框架：仅看预期出口漏掉 46.9% 会话级暴露、攻击者自报混入高假发现，主张基准须声明完整可见边界并连同效用报告隐私。
objective_summary: 提出隐私暴露位移概念与授权感知评估框架 ASLEval，预注册隐藏目标并测量全部可见出口，跨多环境与独立运行时量化局部评估代理的系统性遗漏。
evidence_note: 多环境×独立实现运行时的交叉验证+独立人工评审裁决；环境与规模细节有限，46.9% 等结论基于自建环境。
novelty_note: 命名并量化「局部评估代理与会话级暴露的系统性错位」是评估方法论层面的新问题切入，直接影响后续智能体隐私基准的设计。
scope: 结论适用于工具使用型 LLM 智能体的隐私评估方法学；对无工具调用的对话隐私与多模态暴露未覆盖。
limitations: 环境为企业风格自建场景，绝对比例外推需谨慎；授权标注依赖人工预注册；对适应性攻击策略未评估。

title: CASHEWS: Source Preprocessor for LLM-based Malicious Package Detection
abstract: Malicious npm package detection tools now leverage LLMs' semantic understanding of source code to detect malicious intent at scale. This capability has proven invaluable in identifying packages involved in recent supply-chain attacks such as Shai-Hulud. However, threat actors exploit the limited context windows of LLMs through JavaScript techniques such as code obfuscation that yields high token density and bundling malicious code with benign packages, causing detectors to skip large files or miss malicious behavior. This creates an attack surface for evading detection. In this paper, we present CASHEWS, a JavaScript preprocessor that reduces file size by rewriting source code to remove code that is irrelevant to analysis or likely to mislead the model. Given a package source file, CASHEWS deobfuscates it through iterative decoding, extracts bundled modules and dynamically executed code, identifies malicious sinks and computes backward slices that reach them, and abbreviates long literals and identifiers to produce a compact representation for the detector. Across 512 large package files, two scanner types, and three LLMs, CASHEWS increases analysis coverage from 69.1--85.7% to 98.8--100% and reduces the false-negative rate by up to 18.6 percentage points. CASHEWS also has a median preprocessing time of 30 seconds while reducing net analysis cost by 34.6%, making registry-wide LLM-based analysis more practical. By preprocessing source code before analysis, CASHEWS enables researchers and industry practitioners to use more powerful models for malicious package detection at the same or lower analysis cost as less powerful models.
title_cn: CASHEWS：面向 LLM 恶意包检测的源码预处理器
abstract_cn: 恶意 npm 包检测工具如今利用 LLM 对源码的语义理解来大规模识别恶意意图，这在与 Shai-Hulud 相关供应链攻击的识别中被证明极具价值。但攻击者利用 LLM 有限的上下文窗口，通过代码混淆（产生高令牌密度）与把恶意代码和良性包捆绑等 JavaScript 技术使检测器跳过大文件或漏掉恶意行为，制造出规避检测的攻击面。本文提出 CASHEWS，一个 JavaScript 预处理器，通过重写源码移除与分析无关或可能误导模型的内容来缩减文件体积。给定包源文件，CASHEWS 迭代解码去混淆、提取捆绑模块与动态执行代码、识别恶意汇点并计算到达汇点的反向切片，再缩写长字面量与标识符，产出紧凑表示供检测器使用。在 512 个大文件、两类扫描器与三个 LLM 上，CASHEWS 把分析覆盖率从 69.1–85.7% 提升到 98.8–100%，假阴率最多降低 18.6 个百分点；预处理中位耗时 30 秒，同时把净分析成本降低 34.6%，让注册表级 LLM 分析更实用。通过在分析前预处理源码，CASHEWS 让研究者与业界能以与弱模型相当或更低的成本使用更强模型做恶意包检测。
summary_cn: 恶意包检测预处理 CASHEWS：去混淆+切片到恶意汇点压缩代码，512 文件上分析覆盖率 69.1–85.7%→98.8–100%、假阴率最多降 18.6pp、成本反降 34.6%。
objective_summary: 提出 JavaScript 预处理器 CASHEWS，通过迭代去混淆、捆绑模块提取、恶意汇点反向切片与字面量缩写压缩源码，提升 LLM 恶意包检测的覆盖率与召回。
evidence_note: 512 个大文件×两类扫描器×三个 LLM 的系统对比，覆盖率、假阴率与成本三项量化；数据集构成与统计检验未详述。
novelty_note: 针对 LLM 检测器的「混淆+捆绑」规避面给出系统化预处理方案，把切片/去混淆等经典技术组合成新管线；单项技术均有出处。
scope: 结论适用于 npm 生态 JavaScript 大文件与所测两类扫描器、三个 LLM；对非 JS 语言与运行时行为检测未覆盖。
limitations: 预处理平均 30 秒对注册表级全量扫描仍有成本；对专为绕过切片设计的恶意代码未评估；重写可能引入检测噪声。

title: Locus: A Framework for Exploring and Optimizing Point Addition Hardware for Zero-Knowledge Proofs
abstract: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) are critical for privacy-preserving and verifiable computation, but their cryptographic primitives impose high computational overheads. One such primitive is point addition (PADD) on elliptic curves. Several prior works have implemented PADDs in hardware, but only for a few specific elliptic curves and design points, leaving a large design space unexplored, and lacking systematic guidance on hardware design trade-offs. To address this gap, we present Locus, a framework dedicated to optimizing and exploring point addition hardware. Given the parameters of any elliptic curve in a supported equation form, Locus automatically generates ASIC and FPGA implementations of PADD, enabling systematic exploration of the PADD design space. Using Locus, we conduct the first comprehensive hardware-focused study of PADD designs, exploring trade-offs over 1,000 design points. On a 12nm technology node, our framework produces PADD designs that yield a $2.71\times$ geomean speedup and $3.11\times$ geomean area reduction compared to prior ASICs, $34.67\times$ geomean speedup over CPU, and $3.15\times$ geomean speedup on end-to-end proof generation when integrated into a prior ZKP accelerator at iso-area. Locus is available at https://github.com/cryptolets/cryptolets/tree/locus.
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables. Accepted at the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
title_cn: Locus：零知识证明点加硬件的探索与优化框架
abstract_cn: 零知识证明（ZKP）对隐私保护与可验证计算至关重要，但其密码原语带来高计算开销。椭圆曲线点加（PADD）即是这样一种原语。已有工作在硬件上实现过 PADD，但仅覆盖少数特定曲线与设计点，大量设计空间未被探索，也缺乏对硬件设计权衡的系统指引。为此我们提出 Locus，一个致力于优化与探索点加硬件的框架：给定受支持方程形式下任意椭圆曲线的参数，Locus 自动生成 PADD 的 ASIC 与 FPGA 实现，支持 PADD 设计空间的系统探索。用 Locus，我们完成了首个面向硬件的 PADD 设计综合研究，探索 1,000 多个设计点的权衡。在 12nm 工艺节点上，该框架产出的 PADD 设计较既有 ASIC 实现几何平均提速 2.71 倍、面积减少 3.11 倍，较 CPU 几何平均提速 34.67 倍，集成进既有 ZKP 加速器后等面积下端到端证明生成提速 3.15 倍。Locus 已开源于 https://github.com/cryptolets/cryptolets/tree/locus。
summary_cn: ZKP 点加硬件自动化框架 Locus（ICCAD 2026）：探索 1,000+ 设计点，12nm 下较既有 ASIC 几何平均提速 2.71×、面积省 3.11×，端到端证明生成提速 3.15×，已开源。
objective_summary: 提出自动生成椭圆曲线点加 ASIC/FPGA 实现的框架 Locus，系统性探索 1,000+ 设计点权衡并与既有 ASIC、CPU 及 ZKP 加速器做定量对比。
evidence_note: 1,000+ 设计点的系统探索、12nm ASIC 与 FPGA 双路实现、与既有 ASIC/CPU/ZKP 加速器的等面积对比；ICCAD 2026 录用且框架开源。
novelty_note: 点加硬件的方向首个系统化探索与自动化生成框架（「该方向首个系统化」）；自动化生成方法学本身承袭高层综合传统。
scope: 结论适用于受支持方程形式的椭圆曲线与 12nm/FPGA 目标工艺；对其他曲线形式、更先进节点与软件栈协同优化未覆盖。
limitations: 仅聚焦点加原语而非完整证明系统；框架支持的方程形式有限；与最新全定制设计的对比不完整。

title: Epsilon-Nash Equilibria in History-Dependent SA-MDPs
abstract: We study state-adversarial Markov decision processes (SA-MDP) as a game of observation-space attacks: at each step, an agent selects an action from a received observation while an adversary$\unicode{x2014}$who knows the true state the agent is in$\unicode{x2014}$chooses a perturbed observation within a state-dependent proximity set. While existing work focuses on Markovian policies, we develop a solution concept and computational approach for SA-MDPs under history dependence. This is motivated by results showing that history dependence can materially change equilibrium outcomes and can force both the agent and the adversary to adapt their strategies. First, we prove the non-existence of universal (agnostic of the initial state distribution) history-dependent equilibrium policies. In response to this finding, our main result presents the first algorithmic route to computing $\epsilon$-approximations of initial-state dependent equilibria. We do so by reducing SA-MDPs to a strategically equivalent constrained zero-sum one-sided partially observable stochastic game. We conclude by testing our algorithm on small analytically verifiable games and showing it scales to larger, more realistic benchmarks, including Atari Freeway rollouts with a 12-period ahead horizon.
title_cn: 历史依赖 SA-MDP 中的 ε-Nash 均衡
abstract_cn: 我们把状态对抗马尔可夫决策过程（SA-MDP）研究为观测空间攻击的博弈：每一步，智能体根据接收到的观测选择动作，而知晓智能体真实状态的对手在该状态相关的邻近集合内选择受扰观测。现有工作聚焦马尔可夫策略，我们发展了历史依赖下 SA-MDP 的解概念与计算方法。动机在于已有结果表明历史依赖能实质改变均衡结果并迫使智能体与对手都调整策略。首先，我们证明通用（与初始状态分布无关）历史依赖均衡策略的不存在性。作为回应，我们的主要结果给出了计算初始状态依赖均衡 ε-近似的首个算法路径：把 SA-MDP 归约为策略等价的受约束零和单边部分可观测随机博弈。最后，我们在可解析验证的小博弈上测试算法，并展示其可扩展到更大更现实的基准，包括带 12 周期前瞻视界的 Atari Freeway 轨迹。
summary_cn: 证明历史依赖 SA-MDP 无通用均衡策略，并给出计算初始状态依赖 ε-均衡的首个算法：归约为零和单边 POSG，在可验证小博弈与 Atari Freeway 上验证。
objective_summary: 研究观测攻击下历史依赖 SA-MDP 的均衡：证明通用历史依赖均衡策略不存在，把问题归约为受约束零和单边 POSG 并给出 ε-近似的计算算法与实验。
evidence_note: 不存在性证明与归约构造完整，算法在可解析验证的小博弈上校验并扩展到 Atari Freeway（12 周期前瞻）；实验规模有限，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 SA-MDP 均衡分析从马尔可夫策略扩展到历史依赖并给出首个可计算路径，属既有问题内的实质性理论推进；归约技术承袭 POSG 文献。
scope: 结论适用于观测扰动型 SA-MDP 与可归约的受约束零和单边 POSG；对多智能体、连续动作空间与更长远视界未覆盖。
limitations: ε-近似算法的计算成本随视界增长；实验限于小博弈与 Freeway；对手观测邻近集合的设定为理论假设。

title: Differential Trust: Dynamic Multi-Authority Anonymous Credentials with Epoch-Weighted Updates
abstract: Anonymous credentials (ACs) are fundamental to privacy-preserving authentication, allowing users to prove possession of attributes without revealing their identities. State-of-the-art ACs distribute credential issuance across multiple authorities, typically employing techniques such as Shamir's secret sharing or aggregate signatures. While this approach enhances system robustness and eliminates a single point of failure, it treats all authorities equally in the credential issuance phase. This uniform treatment disregards the varying levels of trustworthiness or stake held by different authorities. Such a limitation has become particularly problematic in modern decentralized systems like Proof-of-Stake networks, where the inherent trust differentiation among nodes cannot be leveraged in the credential issuance process. To address this limitation, we propose the notion of Multi-Authority Anonymous Credentials with Epoch-Based Weights (MA-ACEW), the first Multi-Authority Anonymous Credential (MA-AC) model that considers authorities' weight distribution in credential issuance. Crucially, MA-ACEW enables efficient credential updates when authority weight distributions change across epochs. The core of MA-ACEW is our novel Epoch-Bound Pointcheval-Sanders Signature (EB-PS) primitive, which binds signatures to specific time epochs. This temporal binding enables both weight-based credential issuance within epochs and efficient non-interactive credential updates across epochs. We formalize the EUF-eCMA unforgeability requirement for EB-PS and prove our construction satisfies it under a novel STB-GPS assumption. We then prove that our MA-ACEW construction achieves unforgeability, anonymity, and blindness. Finally, we present benchmarks demonstrating the efficiency of EB-PS and MA-ACEW. Remarkably, presenting a credential aggregated from 128 partial ones takes only 10.68 ms on average.
comment: 34 pages. Full version of the paper published at the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security '26)
title_cn: 差分信任：带 epoch 权重更新的多机构匿名凭证
abstract_cn: 匿名凭证（AC）是隐私保护认证的基础，允许用户在不暴露身份的情况下证明拥有某些属性。最先进的 AC 把凭证签发分散到多个机构，通常采用 Shamir 秘密共享或聚合签名等技术。这增强了系统鲁棒性并消除单点故障，但在凭证签发阶段对所有机构一视同仁。这种统一对待忽视了不同机构可信度或权益的差异；在权益证明网络这类现代去中心化系统中，节点间固有的信任差异无法在凭证签发中利用，问题尤为突出。为解决该局限，我们提出带 epoch 权重的多机构匿名凭证（MA-ACEW）——首个考虑机构权重分布的 MA-AC 模型。关键在于当机构权重分布跨 epoch 变化时 MA-ACEW 能高效更新凭证。其核心是新原语：epoch 绑定 Pointcheval-Sanders 签名（EB-PS），把签名绑定到特定时间 epoch；这一时间绑定同时支持 epoch 内基于权重的凭证签发与跨 epoch 的高效非交互凭证更新。我们形式化 EB-PS 的 EUF-eCMA 不可伪造性要求，并在新假设 STB-GPS 下证明构造满足之；进而证明 MA-ACEW 构造的不可伪造性、匿名性与盲性。最后给出展示 EB-PS 与 MA-ACEW 效率的基准：呈现一个由 128 个部分凭证聚合的凭证平均只需 10.68 毫秒。
summary_cn: USENIX Sec'26：首个按机构权重签发并支持跨 epoch 非交互更新的多机构匿名凭证 MA-ACEW，核心为新原语 EB-PS，128 份部分凭证聚合呈现仅 10.68 毫秒。
objective_summary: 提出首个考虑机构权重分布的多机构匿名凭证模型 MA-ACEW，以新原语 epoch 绑定 PS 签名实现 epoch 内加权签发与跨 epoch 非交互更新，并给出安全证明与基准。
evidence_note: 完整形式化（EUF-eCMA、STB-GPS 新假设）+不可伪造/匿名/盲性三性质证明+效率基准（128 份聚合 10.68ms）；USENIX Security '26 录用。
novelty_note: 首个在签发阶段纳入机构权重分布并可跨 epoch 非交互更新的 MA-AC 模型，配套新原语 EB-PS，属匿名凭证方向的实质新构造。
scope: 结论适用于多机构匿名凭证场景（含 PoS 式权重差异）；安全性依赖新假设 STB-GPS 的成立。
limitations: 新假设需密码学界进一步检验；权重分布由谁设定与更新的治理问题未展开；仅报告 microbenchmark，未做端到端系统集成评估。

title: s-MDM: Generative Virtualization of Multi-Device Hardware Variations for Portable DL-SCA
abstract: Deep Learning-based Side-Channel Analysis (DL-SCA) frequently suffers from catastrophic performance degradation across unseen hardware due to printed circuit board routing differences, silicon process variations, and measurement noise shifts. This poster presents the Synthetic Multiple Device Model (s-MDM), a zero-target-trace generative framework designed to improve cross-device portability. s-MDM combines a structured cVAE generator, a Walsh-Hadamard leakage anchor, continuous style modulation, and decoupled leakage-style--domain critics to synthesize virtual source-device profiles offline. Benchmarked on 32-bit side-channel traces (AES_PTv2), s-MDM maps a precise operational boundary: while physical MDM remains superior on identical electrical clones (D4), s-MDM achieves consistently low key rank on the layout/acquisition-shifted Pinata target, where physical baselines are unstable or misaligned.
title_cn: s-MDM：面向便携式深度学习侧信道分析的生成式多设备虚拟化
abstract_cn: 基于深度学习的侧信道分析（DL-SCA）常因印刷电路板布线差异、硅工艺变异与测量噪声漂移，在未见硬件上遭遇灾难性性能退化。本海报提出合成多设备模型（s-MDM），一个零目标轨迹的生成式框架，旨在提升跨设备可移植性。s-MDM 结合结构化 cVAE 生成器、Walsh-Hadamard 泄漏锚点、连续风格调制与解耦的泄漏-风格-域判别器，离线合成虚拟源设备剖面。在 32 位侧信道轨迹（AES_PTv2）上基准测试，s-MDM 划出一条清晰的运行边界：在完全相同的电气克隆（D4）上物理 MDM 仍占优，而在布局/采集偏移的 Pinata 目标上，s-MDM 保持一致的低密钥秩，物理基线则不稳定或错位。
summary_cn: 海报 s-MDM：cVAE 生成零目标轨迹的虚拟设备剖面提升 DL-SCA 跨设备可移植性，在布局/采集偏移的 Pinata 目标上保持低密钥秩而物理基线失效。
objective_summary: 提出零目标轨迹的生成式框架 s-MDM，用结构化 cVAE 等组件离线合成虚拟源设备剖面以改善 DL-SCA 跨设备可移植性，并在 AES_PTv2 轨迹上划定适用边界。
evidence_note: 海报论文：仅 AES_PTv2 一组轨迹上的 D4/Pinata 对比，目标数量与统计检验有限，属初步实验。
novelty_note: 用生成式虚拟设备替代物理多设备采集来解跨设备域移位是新路线；cVAE/域判别器组件为既有技术。
scope: 结论适用于 AES_PTv2 类 32 位轨迹与布局/采集偏移型设备差异；对完全未知芯片与其他算法未覆盖。
limitations: 评估限于单算法单数据集；合成剖面对高噪声环境的保真度未验证；海报篇幅限制了消融细节。

title: Normal Alignment: Improved Cryptanalytic Sign Recovery on Hard-Label Networks
abstract: At EUROCRYPT 2025, Carlini et al. proposed a breakthrough in the cryptanalytic extraction on hard-label (S1) deep neural networks (DNNs), demonstrating polynomial-time signature and sign recovery. However, Carlini et al.'s sign-recovery method (which we call Future Toggle) suffers only a marginal advantage over random guessing, producing high-confidence wrong sign predictions in deeper layers. Such errors trigger expensive exponential-time enumeration. This work presents Normal Alignment, a novel statistical sign-recovery approach for S1 DNNs. Drawing on the expected length difference between projected normals of adjacent decision facets at dual points, our method infers neuron signs via normal-signature alignment. It delivers higher voting accuracy and pushes erroneous predictions to low-confidence ranks, which further enables a more efficient combined method, eSOE + Alignment, by combining Normal Alignment with the hard-label SOE extension. This combined strategy removes heavy enumeration overhead and realizes exact polynomial-time full sign recovery. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, especially for deep layers. For example, with our method, the signs for CIFAR-10 (architecture 192-64$\times$8-10) and MNIST (architecture 64-96$\times$3-32-10) models can be fully recovered in polynomial time; in contrast, Carlini et al.'s sign-recovery method would require exponential-time enumerations involving $2^{52}$ or $2^{82}$ guesses of the signs, respectively.
title_cn: 法向对齐：硬标签网络上的改进密码分析符号恢复
abstract_cn: 在 EUROCRYPT 2025，Carlini 等人在硬标签（S1）深度神经网络的密码分析提取上取得突破，展示了多项式时间的签名与符号恢复。然而 Carlini 等人的符号恢复方法（我们称之为 Future Toggle）相对随机 guessing 只有边际优势，且在更深层产生高置信的错误符号预测；这类错误会触发昂贵的指数时间枚举。本工作提出 Normal Alignment，一种面向 S1 DNN 的新型统计符号恢复方法。借助对偶点处相邻决策面的投影法向量期望长度差，我们的方法通过法向签名对齐推断神经元符号，带来更高投票准确率并把错误预测推到低置信排名；这进一步促成把 Normal Alignment 与硬标签 SOE 扩展结合的更高效组合方法 eSOE + Alignment，消除繁重枚举开销并实现精确的多项式时间全符号恢复。实验表明方法的有效性，尤其在深层：用我们的方法，CIFAR-10（架构 192-64×8-10）与 MNIST（架构 64-96×3-32-10）模型的符号可全多项式时间恢复；而 Carlini 等人的符号恢复方法将分别需要 2^52 或 2^82 次符号猜测的指数时间枚举。
summary_cn: 改进 EUROCRYPT 2025 硬标签 DNN 符号恢复：Normal Alignment 以法向签名对齐消除指数枚举，CIFAR-10/MNIST 模型全符号多项式时间恢复（原方法需 2^52/2^82 次猜测）。
objective_summary: 提出基于对偶点法向签名对齐的硬标签 DNN 统计符号恢复方法 Normal Alignment，与 eSOE 组合实现多项式时间全符号恢复并实验对比 Carlini 等人的方法。
evidence_note: 在 CIFAR-10/MNIST 多架构上与 Carlini et al.（EUROCRYPT 2025）直接对比，多项式时间恢复有实证支持；数据集规模有限，更大模型未测。
novelty_note: 对 EUROCRYPT 2025 方法的实质改进：新统计机制（法向签名对齐）把符号恢复从指数枚举降到多项式时间，属该问题上的显著推进。
scope: 结论适用于硬标签（S1）全连接类 DNN 的符号/签名恢复；对卷积主干、Transformer 与防御加固后的模型未覆盖。
limitations: 实验限于 CIFAR-10/MNIST 规模模型；对带防御的部署模型与查询预算受限场景未评估；理论保证依赖对偶点几何性质。

title: Echo: Learning-based Matching Decompilation using Trusted Back Translation
abstract: Neural decompilers can recover readable and recompilable source code from binaries, but their predictions remain difficult to trust. Matching decompilation addresses this problem by searching for source code whose recompiled assembly exactly matches the target, providing stronger evidence of correctness. However, exact matching remains challenging for optimized binaries under unknown compilation configurations. We present Echo, a matching decompilation system based on trusted back-translation. Our key insight is to use compilation not only for verification, but also as trusted feedback to guide iterative search. Echo first uses a domain-specific model to generate candidate programs and compilation configurations. It recompiles these candidates, measures assembly-level similarity, and synthesizes promising code-configuration pairs. Remaining mismatches are then progressively repaired using rule-based rewriting, neural refinement, and reasoning-based refinement. We evaluate Echo on function-level benchmarks and the Mirai malware binary. Compared with the strongest baseline, Echo produces 2.43x more exact matches on average and achieves the highest structural similarity to ground-truth source code. On Mirai, Echo matches 2.75x and 7.4x as many functions as GPT-5.6 and Codex, respectively.
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures
title_cn: Echo：基于可信回译的学习式匹配反编译
abstract_cn: 神经反编译器能从二进制恢复可读、可重编译的源码，但其预测难以令人信任。匹配反编译通过搜索其重编译汇编与目标精确一致的源码来解决这个问题，提供更强的正确性证据。但在未知编译配置的优化二进制上，精确匹配仍很困难。我们提出 Echo，一个基于可信回译的匹配反编译系统。关键洞见是把编译不仅用作验证，还用作引导迭代搜索的可信反馈。Echo 先用领域专用模型生成候选程序与编译配置，重编译候选、度量汇编级相似度并合成有希望的代码-配置对；剩余不匹配再经基于规则的重写、神经细化与推理细化逐步修复。我们在函数级基准与 Mirai 恶意软件二进制上评估 Echo。与最强基线相比，Echo 平均产出 2.43 倍的精确匹配，并取得对地面真值源码的最高结构相似度；在 Mirai 上，Echo 匹配的函数数量分别是 GPT-5.6 与 Codex 的 2.75 倍与 7.4 倍。
summary_cn: 匹配反编译系统 Echo：把重编译当可信回译反馈引导搜索，函数级基准精确匹配较最强基线多 2.43 倍，Mirai 上匹配函数为 GPT-5.6/Codex 的 2.75/7.4 倍。
objective_summary: 提出以编译为可信反馈引导迭代搜索的匹配反编译系统 Echo，用规则重写、神经与推理细化逐步修复不匹配，在函数级基准与 Mirai 二进制上评估。
evidence_note: 函数级基准+Mirai 真实恶意软件二进制上的定量对比（2.43×、2.75×、7.4×）与结构相似度指标；基准构成与统计检验未详述。
novelty_note: 把编译从「验证」扩展为「引导搜索的可信反馈」并配多级细化管线，是对匹配反编译难题的实质机制改进；匹配反编译问题本身已有定义。
scope: 结论适用于函数级二进制（含 Mirai 类）与 Echo 支持的编译配置空间；对 strip/混淆严重或非函数粒度目标未评估。
limitations: 精确匹配率仍非 100%，未报告失败模式分布；依赖领域专用模型的候选质量；多轮重编译与细化的计算开销未量化。

title: CaMeLoT: CaMeL orchestrated with Temporal logic for static verification and liveness
abstract: LLM-based agents generate and execute multi-step plans that invoke external tools which can access private data or execute commands. In this setting, security is a property of the entire execution that a plan creates, not just any single step. The plan itself is a critical artefact that captures the tool calls, control flow, and data dependencies. We present CaMeLoT, a complement to CaMeL, an existing defence against prompt injection in tool-using LLM agents. CaMeLoT extends CaMeL by adding a static verification layer that checks an agent's plan before any tool is invoked. CaMeLoT translates a generated plan into a finite-state transition system, labels it with tool calls, provenance and taint information, and checks it against temporal policies expressed in CTL using the nuXmv model checker. Because verification happens before execution, unsafe plans are rejected without using LLM calls or tool calls, saving tokens that runtime could have cost, as well as the need to unwind changes or teardown temporary sandboxes. When a verification fails, the model checker returns a counterexample to give feedback to the agent to repair the plan. We evaluate CaMeLoT on policies derived from the AgentDojo benchmark, SOC workflows, and prompt-extraction experiments, showing that it verifies a broad class of temporal properties before execution while preserving CaMeL's runtime-checkable coverage.
comment: Accepted at CAMLIS 2026 (Conference on Applied Machine Learning in Information Security)
title_cn: CaMeLoT：以时序逻辑编排 CaMeL 做静态验证与活性
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的智能体生成并执行调用外部工具的多步计划，这些工具可访问私有数据或执行命令。在此场景下，安全是整个执行所创建计划的属性，而非任何单步的属性；计划本身是捕获工具调用、控制流与数据依赖的关键工件。我们提出 CaMeLoT，作为 CaMeL——一种针对工具使用型 LLM 智能体提示注入的既有防御——的补充。CaMeLoT 为 CaMeL 增加静态验证层，在任何工具被调用前检查智能体的计划：把生成的计划翻译为有限状态转移系统，标注工具调用、溯源与污点信息，并用 nuXmv 模型检查器对照以 CTL 表达的时间策略进行校验。由于验证发生在执行前，不安全计划在未消耗 LLM 调用与工具调用的情况下即被拒绝，节省了运行时本要花费的令牌，也免去回滚变更或拆除临时沙箱。验证失败时，模型检查器返回反例供智能体修复计划。我们在从 AgentDojo 基准、SOC 工作流与提示抽取实验导出的策略上评估 CaMeLoT，表明它能在执行前验证广泛类别的时间性质，同时保持 CaMeL 运行时可检查的覆盖面。
summary_cn: 为 CaMeL 增加执行前静态验证层 CaMeLoT：计划翻译为 CTL 模型检查（nuXmv），不安全计划零令牌拒绝并返回反例修复，覆盖 AgentDojo 派生策略与 SOC 工作流。
objective_summary: 为 CaMeL 增加执行前静态验证层：把智能体计划翻译为带溯源/污点标注的有限状态系统并用 nuXmv 检查 CTL 策略，失败时返回反例供修复。
evidence_note: AgentDojo 派生策略、SOC 工作流与提示抽取实验上的评估，并与 CaMeL 运行时覆盖面对照；CAMLIS 2026 录用；基准规模与成功率细节未在摘要给出。
novelty_note: 把计划级 CTL 模型检查与 CaMeL 运行时溯源控制组合成「执行前拒绝+反例修复」是实质新机制；单独的模型检查与溯源标注均有成熟基础。
scope: 结论适用于可翻译为有限状态转移系统的智能体计划与可 CTL 表达的策略；对运行时才可判定的性质与不可建模的动态工具行为不适用。
limitations: 只覆盖可静态建模的计划性质，运行时违规仍需 CaMeL 兜底；翻译保真度依赖 LLM 计划的结构化程度；评估基准规模未详述。

title: A Security Risk Assessment Framework for AI-Powered Development Tools
abstract: AI-powered development tools are now widely used to generate code and assist developers with routine programming tasks. Although existing work has identified vulnerabilities in AI-generated code, security-oriented work is often focused on vulnerability detection rather than risk assessment. To address this gap, this paper presents a Security Risk Assessment Framework (SRF) to evaluate the security risks of AI-generated code. SRF combines threat modeling, security analysis, and a quantitative risk evaluation approach based on vulnerability criticality. The framework is applied to a set of security-relevant programming tasks, where code generated by multiple AI-powered development tools is analyzed using Bandit and Semgrep. The results show that AI-generated code can introduce security vulnerabilities across all evaluated tools. They also show that risk levels vary by task type, as input processing and file handling tasks showed higher risk, while simpler tasks remained low-risk. Differences between tools exist but are smaller than differences across task categories. Overall, SRF enables reproducible evaluation of AI-generated code and provides a practical framework for assessing its security implications.
title_cn: AI 开发工具的安全风险评估框架
abstract_cn: AI 驱动的开发工具已被广泛用于生成代码并协助开发者完成日常编程任务。尽管已有工作发现 AI 生成代码中的漏洞，面向安全的工作多聚焦漏洞检测而非风险评估。为填补这一空白，本文提出安全风险评估框架（SRF），用于评估 AI 生成代码的安全风险。SRF 结合威胁建模、安全分析与基于漏洞危重度量的量化风险评估方法。该框架被应用于一组安全相关编程任务，用 Bandit 与 Semgrep 分析多个 AI 开发工具生成的代码。结果显示，所有被评估工具生成的代码都可能引入安全漏洞；风险等级随任务类型而变——输入处理与文件处理任务风险更高，而较简单任务保持低风险；工具间差异存在但小于任务类别间差异。总体而言，SRF 让 AI 生成代码的评估可复现，并为评估其安全影响提供实用框架。
summary_cn: AI 生成代码的安全风险评估框架 SRF：用 Bandit/Semgrep 分析多工具输出，发现输入处理与文件处理类任务风险最高，工具间差异小于任务类别差异。
objective_summary: 提出结合威胁建模、静态分析与危重度量的风险评估框架 SRF，并用 Bandit/Semgrep 对多个 AI 开发工具生成代码做风险量化对比。
evidence_note: 基于 Bandit/Semgrep 扫描结果的风险量化，任务与工具数量未在摘要给出，无统计检验与人工确认漏洞的说明。
novelty_note: AI 生成代码的安全评估已有大量工作；SRF 的增量是把检测输出整合为危重度量与任务维度的风险比较，属框架化整理。
scope: 结论适用于所测 AI 编码工具在安全相关编程任务上的静态扫描风险；不外推到运行时漏洞、供应链风险或人工审查场景。
limitations: 依赖 Bandit/Semgrep 的已知模式库，漏报未校准；AI 工具与任务集规模未详述；风险权重设定主观。

title: The Illusion of Local Privacy: Confidentiality Boundary Failures in Consumer LLM Serving Systems
abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) locally is often considered more private than cloud-hosted inference because user prompts remain on the device. We ask whether keeping inference local is, by itself, sufficient to keep those prompts confidential. Our results show that it is not: prompt confidentiality also depends on how the surrounding serving software handles prompt data before, during, and after inference. We examine four boundaries at which prompt confidentiality can fail in consumer local-LLM serving systems: model loading, runtime memory, wrapper-level persistence, and the serving interface. To study these boundaries, we develop LLAnalyzer, a measurement framework that tests each boundary separately and traces observed failures to the responsible software component. Applying LLAnalyzer to four open-weight model families and two consumer deployment platforms, we find markedly different behaviour across boundaries. In a 24-hour AFL++ campaign with more than 12 million executions, we observe no parser crashes or successful malformed GGUF loads within the explored state space. Runtime memory tells a different story: we recover prompts after inference because multiple plaintext representations survive in allocator-managed memory, and sanitisation reduces this residue without eliminating it. We also find that consumer wrappers can extend prompt lifetime through plaintext persistence. At the serving boundary, we uncover a previously undocumented authorization flaw in llama.cpp that allows one authenticated client to restore another tenant's saved conversation state; the attack succeeds in 200/200 controlled trials. Separately, shared prompt-prefix caching exposes a remote timing oracle that remains distinguishable under WAN conditions. We argue that local LLM systems need explicit guarantees for prompt lifetime, persistent storage, and tenant isolation.
comment: 20 pages, 1 figure, 12 tables. Code and experimental artifacts: this https URL, Preprint under review for IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (T-IFS)
title_cn: 本地隐私的幻象：消费级 LLM 服务系统的机密性边界失效
abstract_cn: 在本地运行大语言模型（LLM）常被认为比云端推理更私密，因为用户提示留在设备上。我们追问：把推理留在本地是否本身就足以保证提示机密性？结果表明并非如此：提示机密性还取决于周边服务软件在推理前、中、后如何处理提示数据。我们考察消费级本地 LLM 服务系统中提示机密性可能失效的四个边界：模型加载、运行时内存、包装器级持久化与服务接口。为此我们开发 LLAnalyzer——一个分别测试各边界并把观察到的失效追溯到责任软件组件的测量框架。将 LLAnalyzer 应用于四个开放权重模型家族与两个消费级部署平台，我们发现各边界行为差异显著。在 24 小时、超过 1200 万次执行的 AFL++ 活动中，我们在探索的状态空间内未观察到解析器崩溃或畸形 GGUF 载入成功。运行时内存则是另一番情形：由于分配器管理的内存中残留多个明文表示，我们能在推理后恢复提示；净化可减少但不消除这种残留。我们还发现消费级包装器可通过明文持久化延长提示寿命。在服务边界，我们发现 llama.cpp 中一个此前未记录的授权缺陷：一个已认证客户端可恢复另一租户保存的会话状态，攻击在 200/200 次受控试验中成功。另外，共享提示前缀缓存暴露出一个在广域网条件下仍可区分的远程时序预言。我们主张本地 LLM 系统需要对提示寿命、持久存储与租户隔离的显式保证。
summary_cn: 本地 LLM ≠ 提示机密：LLAnalyzer 实测四边界失效——内存残留可恢复提示、llama.cpp 跨租户会话恢复缺陷 200/200 成功、前缀缓存暴露 WAN 级时序预言。
objective_summary: 开发 LLAnalyzer 测量框架，系统检验本地 LLM 服务栈四个机密性边界，发现内存残留、包装器持久化、llama.cpp 跨租户恢复缺陷与时序预言。
evidence_note: 四模型家族×两平台系统测量、24 小时 1200 万次执行模糊测试、200/200 受控漏洞验证与 WAN 条件时序实验；代码与实验工件公开，投稿 T-IFS 在审。
novelty_note: 首次系统刻画本地 LLM 服务栈的提示机密性边界并发现未记录的 llama.cpp 跨租户恢复缺陷；对「本地=私密」假设的证伪具普适诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于消费级本地 LLM 部署栈（四开放权重模型家族、两平台与 llama.cpp 类服务）；不涉及云端推理与恶意模型权重场景。
limitations: 模糊测试未发现缺陷不代表不存在；净化策略只能减少残留而非根除；时序预言在真实网络抖动下的利用门槛未量化。

title: Robot Visions: Breaking reCAPTCHA at Zero Cost and Zero Shot
abstract: Google reCAPTCHA is the most widely deployed visual CAPTCHA service, protecting hundreds of thousands of websites from automated bots. It serves as a critical line of defense against automated attacks, including credential stuffing, bulk account creation, and automated form abuse. It has proven largely effective since its introduction in 2007. However, the rise of accessible AI now threatens its efficacy. Prior work has demonstrated that commercial cloud-based vision-language models (VLMs) can solve visual CAPTCHA challenges, but at non-trivial monetary cost per attempt. In this paper, we show that free and locally-run models can break Google reCAPTCHA. We conduct a comprehensive study of reCAPTCHA and present a taxonomy of its challenge types: Type A (independent image tiles, with static and dynamic sub-variants) and Type B (a single image partitioned into a 4x4 grid), each demanding a distinct solving strategy. We design zero-shot, no-cost solvers built entirely on open-source local models, specifically CLIP (58% per-challenge accuracy on Type A) and OWLv2 (43.5% on Type B), requiring no model training and no API access. Our end-to-end automated solver achieves a 92.6% per-session success rate across 500 real-world reCAPTCHA sessions. We further demonstrate that reCAPTCHA can be defeated by a non-technical adversary, using only natural-language instructions to a commodity AI assistant. This collapses the practical attacker skill floor to near zero and fundamentally changes the threat model for challenge-based CAPTCHAs. Although reCAPTCHA increasingly favors reputation-based verification, visual challenge-based fallback persists as a safety net that, paradoxically, has become the weakest link in the defense chain, suggesting that challenge-based visual CAPTCHAs may have reached the end of their useful life.
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 29th Information Security Conference (ISC 2026)
title_cn: Robot Visions：零成本零样本攻破 reCAPTCHA
abstract_cn: Google reCAPTCHA 是部署最广的视觉验证码服务，保护数十万网站免受自动化机器人攻击，是抵御撞库、批量注册与自动表单滥用的关键防线。自 2007 年推出以来它总体有效。然而，可获得 AI 的兴起正威胁其效力。先前工作已证明商业云端视觉语言模型（VLM）能解视觉验证码，但每次尝试都有不菲的费用。本文展示免费、本地运行的模型就能攻破 Google reCAPTCHA。我们对 reCAPTCHA 做了全面研究并提出其挑战类型分类：Type A（独立图像块，含静态与动态子变体）与 Type B（单图切分为 4×4 网格），各自需要不同的求解策略。我们设计了完全基于开源本地模型的零样本、零成本求解器——CLIP（Type A 每题准确率 58%）与 OWLv2（Type B 43.5%）——无需模型训练、无需 API。端到端自动求解器在 500 个真实 reCAPTCHA 会话上达到 92.6% 的每会话成功率。我们进一步证明非技术对手仅用商品 AI 助手的自然语言指令即可击败 reCAPTCHA，把实际攻击者技能下限压到近零，从根本上改变基于挑战的验证码威胁模型。尽管 reCAPTCHA 日益倾向基于声誉的验证，视觉挑战回退作为安全网仍然存在——而它吊诡地已成为防御链中最弱一环，提示基于挑战的视觉验证码可能已到使用寿命终点。
summary_cn: 零成本零样本攻破 Google reCAPTCHA：本地 CLIP/OWLv2 求解器在 500 个真实会话达 92.6% 成功率，商品 AI 助手自然语言指令即可复现。
objective_summary: 系统分类 reCAPTCHA 挑战类型并构建基于开源本地模型的零样本求解器，在 500 个真实会话上做端到端在野评估并演示非技术用户攻击路径。
evidence_note: 500 个真实 reCAPTCHA 会话的端到端在野评估（92.6% 会话成功率）+挑战类型系统分类+每类准确率量化；ISC 2026 录用，置信区间未报告。
novelty_note: 商业 VLM 解验证码已有先例；新在证明免费本地零样本模型即可、且非技术用户经商品助手可复现，攻击者技能下限的实证改写具威胁模型层面意义。
scope: 结论适用于 Google reCAPTCHA 的视觉挑战回退与同类基于挑战的视觉验证码；对基于声誉/行为的无挑战验证与私有验证码实现未覆盖。
limitations: 每题准确率中等（58%/43.5%），会话级成功率依赖重试机制；reCAPTCHA 持续迭代可能使结果时效受限；对其他厂商验证码未测。

title: MiST: Mid-Training LLMs for Cybersecurity
abstract: Cybersecurity combines high-stakes analysis with complex technical language, making it an impactful and challenging domain for LLMs. We present MiST (Mid-trained Security Transformer), a suite of 8B and 32B models that achieve strong performance on public cybersecurity benchmarks. We use mid-training as an intermediate adaptation stage between general pre-training and cybersecurity training. Rather than performing continual pre-training over large volumes of raw domain text, we curate a compact, expert-vetted seed corpus, and transform it into high-quality domain-specific synthetic training data. The final MiST checkpoints improve mean cybersecurity accuracy by +13.1 and +8.6 absolute percentage points over the corresponding Qwen baselines for 8B and 32B, respectively, corresponding to relative gains of +27.0% and +15.8%. Ablation results further show that these cybersecurity gains arise in the mid-training and supervised fine-tuning stages through a combination of the synthetic data generation flows. Furthermore, we show that MiST provides a stronger initialization for downstream task-specific fine-tuning adaptation and reinforcement learning.
title_cn: MiST：面向网络安全的中期训练大模型
abstract_cn: 网络安全兼具高风险分析与复杂技术语言，是 LLM 有影响且具挑战的领域。我们提出 MiST（Mid-trained Security Transformer），一套在公开网络安全基准上取得强劲表现的 8B 与 32B 模型。我们把「中期训练」（mid-training）用作通用预训练与网络安全训练之间的中间适配阶段：不在大规模原始领域文本上做持续预训练，而是策划一个紧凑、经专家审核的种子语料，并将其转化为高质量领域专属合成训练数据。最终 MiST 检查点在网络安全基准的平均准确率上比对应 Qwen 基线分别提升 13.1 与 8.6 个绝对百分点（8B 与 32B），对应 27.0% 与 15.8% 的相对增益。消融结果显示这些网络安全增益来自中期训练与监督微调阶段的不同合成数据生成流程的组合。此外我们证明 MiST 为下游任务专用微调适配与强化学习提供了更强的初始化。
summary_cn: 网络安全 LLM MiST（8B/32B）：专家种子语料转合成数据做中期训练，基准平均准确率较 Qwen 基线 +13.1/+8.6 个百分点（相对 +27.0%/+15.8%）。
objective_summary: 构建 8B/32B 网络安全模型套件 MiST，以紧凑专家种子语料转合成数据的中期训练提升领域能力，并做训练阶段消融与下游适配初始化验证。
evidence_note: 公开网络安全基准+Qwen 基线对照+训练阶段消融，增益数字明确；训练数据自建合成、基准套件构成未列全，未报告第三方复测。
novelty_note: 「中期训练」阶段的提法与紧凑种子语料→合成数据的流程是工程化改良；领域持续预训练/微调提升安全能力已有多个先例。
scope: 结论适用于 8B/32B 规模、Qwen 基座与所测公开网络安全基准；对更小模型、其他基座与实际安全运营任务效果未验证。
limitations: 增益限于公开基准的平均准确率，实战任务迁移未测；合成数据流程依赖专家审核的可扩展性；基线选择限于 Qwen 家族。

title: A Global Readiness and Sovereignty Capability Model for Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration
abstract: Cryptographic dependence predates the quantum era, but the migration to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) opens a rare window to reshape it, because the algorithms, implementations, hardware, and standards adopted now can lock in dependence or sovereignty for decades. This paper introduces the Readiness-Sovereignty Capability Model (RSCM), a national measurement model that operationalizes PQC readiness together with cryptographic sovereignty, which current maturity models score only as readiness and the sovereignty literature defines without measuring. RSCM decomposes sovereignty into three distinct constructs, indigenous cryptographic capacity, indigenous post-quantum control, and external dependency, and certifies a post-quantum maker only through a gate requiring demonstrated, institutionally sustained creation in at least one core layer, whether design, implementation, or validation. Applying it to fifty-seven documented cryptographic actors coded from cited public evidence, and testing that coding with an independent second coder, a plausible-state bootstrap, and convergent-validity checks, we find that twenty countries clear the gate, fifteen as full-stack makers and five as research makers, eleven hold strong general capacity without post-quantum control, one is a ready adopter, and twenty-five are dependent. The gate cells show substantial weighted agreement, a quadratic-weighted kappa of 0.71, and the maker classification is stable in its core though uncertain at the threshold. Readiness tracks independent cyber indices at rank correlations up to 0.70, while post-quantum creation shows no significant correlation with the commitment index, a rank correlation of only 0.22 that separates control from readiness. The paper contributes the framework, the evidence-graded assessment, and policy directions for building indigenous quantum-safe capacity.
title_cn: 后量子密码迁移的全球就绪与主权能力模型
abstract_cn: 密码学依赖早于量子时代，但向后量子密码（PQC）的迁移开启了一个重塑依赖关系的罕见窗口，因为现在采用的算法、实现、硬件与标准可能把依赖或主权锁定数十年。本文提出就绪-主权能力模型（RSCM），一个把 PQC 就绪度与密码主权一起操作化的国家测量模型——现行成熟度模型只对就绪度打分，而主权文献只定义不测量。RSCM 把主权分解为三个不同构念：本土密码能力、本土后量子控制与外部依赖，并通过一道门槛认证后量子制造者：要求在至少一个核心层（设计、实现或验证）有经证明、机构化持续的创造。将该模型应用于从引用的公开证据编码的 57 个有据可查的密码行为体，并用独立第二编码者、合理状态自助法与收敛效度检验测试编码，我们发现 20 个国家跨过门槛——15 个为全栈制造者、5 个为研究制造者；11 个具备强一般能力但无后量子控制；1 个为就绪采用者；25 个为依赖方。门槛单元格显示可观的加权一致性（二次加权 kappa 0.71），制造者分类在核心稳定但在阈值处不确定。就绪度与独立网络指数的秩相关高达 0.70，而后量子创造与承诺指数无显著相关（秩相关仅 0.22），将控制与就绪度区分开来。论文贡献了框架、证据分级的评估与建设本土抗量子能力的政策方向。
summary_cn: 测度 PQC 就绪+密码主权的 RSCM 模型：57 个行为体编码显示 20 国过制造者门槛（kappa 0.71），就绪度与网络指数秩相关 0.70，而后量子创造与承诺指数仅 0.22。
objective_summary: 构建把 PQC 就绪度与密码主权一起操作化的国家测量模型 RSCM，对 57 个密码行为体做证据分级编码并验证信度与效度。
evidence_note: 57 个行为体的公开证据编码，配独立第二编码者、二次加权 kappa 0.71、自助法与外部指数收敛效度检验；编码数据自建，阈值处分类不确定（作者自陈）。
novelty_note: 首个把「主权」操作化为可测构念并与就绪度分开打分的 PQC 迁移模型；「创造门槛」认证设计为方法新意。
scope: 结论适用于国家层级的 PQC 能力与依赖结构刻画；编码基于公开证据，不适用于未公开或机密能力，且时点敏感。
limitations: 分类在门槛阈值处不确定（作者自陈）；公开证据可能低估或高估真实能力；57 个行为体的样本与编码者判断依赖。

title: Collective Loss of Control in LLM Agent Systems: An Epidemic Account of Mutation, Contagion, and Recovery
abstract: How does a multi-agent system evolve from a local deviation into collective loss of control? We propose an epidemic explanation organized around accidental mutation, contagion, and recovery. A spontaneous deviation creates a seed; communication enables other agents to adopt and retransmit its unsafe strategy; collective failure can emerge when propagation outpaces correction and containment. Thus, rare individual deviations can coexist with substantial collective risk. Motivated by reported OpenAI agent coordination incidents, we examine two ingredients of this mechanism. A deployment audit identifies implicit communication paths between nominally independent evaluation runs and verifies transport through a default Docker backend. RogueHandoff-20, a benchmark of 20 executable scenarios, tests recipient susceptibility by injecting unsafe trajectories generated by a modified Qwen-27B route. Across four native-pending routes, executed harm is 0-5% on normal tasks and 40-95% after injection, exceeding paired direct malicious requests by 5-45 percentage points. These results support low observed baseline harm alongside high conditional susceptibility; they do not establish natural rare-event rates or demonstrate an autonomous cascade. The account motivates complementary defenses: strengthen resistance and recovery alongside prevention of spontaneous deviations, and audit and restrict unintended communication paths that can turn local failures into collective loss of control.
title_cn: LLM 智能体系统的集体失控：突变、传染与恢复的流行病学解释
abstract_cn: 多智能体系统如何从局部偏差演化为集体失控？我们提出一个围绕意外突变、传染与恢复组织的流行病学解释。自发偏差产生种子；通信使其他智能体采纳并重传其不安全策略；当传播快于纠正与遏制时，集体失败可能出现。因此，罕见的个体偏差可以与显著的集体风险共存。受已报道的 OpenAI 智能体协调事件启发，我们考察该机制的两个要素。部署审计识别了名义上独立的评估运行之间的隐式通信路径，并验证其经由默认 Docker 后端的传输。RogueHandoff-20——一个含 20 个可执行场景的基准——通过注入由修改的 Qwen-27B 路由生成的不安全轨迹来测试接收方易感性。跨四条原生待定路由，正常任务的已执行危害为 0–5%，注入后为 40–95%，比成对的直接恶意请求高 5–45 个百分点。这些结果支持「观察到的基线危害低而条件易感性高」；它们并未确立自然罕见事件发生率，也未证明自主级联。该解释启发了互补防御：在防止自发偏差之外强化抵抗力与恢复力，并审计和限制可能把局部失败转化为集体失控的意外通信路径。
summary_cn: 以流行病学框架解释多智能体集体失控：RogueHandoff-20 基准显示正常任务危害仅 0–5%，注入不安全轨迹后达 40–95%（高于直接恶意请求 5–45 个百分点）。
objective_summary: 提出多智能体集体失控的「突变-传染-恢复」流行病学解释，部署审计实证隐式通信路径，并用 RogueHandoff-20 基准量化注入后接收方易感性。
evidence_note: 部署审计（Docker 隐式通信路径实证）+20 场景可执行基准+四条路由成对对比（0–5% vs 40–95%）；场景自建、无统计检验，作者明确不主张自然发生率。
novelty_note: 「突变-传染-恢复」框架与「条件易感性高而基线危害低」的量化区分是新视角；智能体间策略传染已有先行工作，本文补上部署审计与系统基准。
scope: 结论适用于共享容器/网络基础设施的多智能体部署；未确立自然级联发生概率，威胁模型为注入式种子而非自发涌现。
limitations: 基准仅 20 场景、生成器为单个修改模型；隐式通信路径的枚举限于 Docker 默认配置；恢复机制的防御效果未实验评估。

title: SEEK: Secure and Efficient Encrypted Keyword Search For Privacy-Preserving Messaging Protocols
abstract: Encrypted communication protects sensitive user data but can facilitate harmful or unlawful exchanges, creating a trade-off between detecting dangerous messages and preserving end-user privacy. To address this, we propose SEEK, a practical and efficient encrypted keyword-search protocol for privacy-preserving messaging that combines homomorphic encryption with secure two-party computation (2PC). SEEK first partitions messages into ciphertext fragments with the minimum sufficient overlap, then homomorphically correlates them using encrypted keyword trapdoors. For long messages, this design can reduce sender-side encryption and upload overhead by up to two orders of magnitude over state-of-the-art baselines. It supports ASCII case-insensitive matching with one fixed-size encrypted trapdoor and one homomorphic multiplication per fragment, yielding up to 5.47x faster correlation computation than the strongest fragmentation-based baselines. SEEK then invokes 2PC-based selected decoding, blinded zero testing, and secure aggregation, revealing only the keyword presence-or-absence bit while hiding the keyword, its length, message contents, match counts, and locations. SEEK achieves 100% accuracy under case variations that result in exact-matching failures, without requiring additional trapdoors or online communication. We further realize SEEK as an end-to-end web and cross-platform mobile application. Prototype evaluation on a weekly messaging history yields an online computation time of 1.92 s per search, demonstrating the practical feasibility and efficiency of SEEK.
title_cn: SEEK：面向隐私保护消息协议的安全高效加密关键词搜索
abstract_cn: 加密通信保护敏感用户数据，但也可能助长有害或非法交流，在检测危险消息与保护终端用户隐私之间形成两难。为此我们提出 SEEK，一个面向隐私保护消息传递的实用高效加密关键词搜索协议，结合同态加密与安全两方计算（2PC）。SEEK 先把消息分割为具有最小充分重叠的密文片段，再用加密关键词陷门进行同态相关运算。对长消息，该设计能把发送端加密与上传开销较最先进基线降低最多两个数量级。它支持 ASCII 大小写不敏感匹配，每片段只需一个固定尺寸加密陷门与一次同态乘法，相关计算比最强的基于分片的基线快至多 5.47 倍。SEEK 随后调用基于 2PC 的选择性解码、盲零测试与安全聚合，只透露关键词存在与否的比特，同时隐藏关键词本身、其长度、消息内容、匹配计数与位置。在导致精确匹配失败的大小写变体下，SEEK 无需额外陷门或在线通信即达 100% 准确率。我们进一步把 SEEK 实现为端到端网页与跨平台移动应用。在一周消息历史原型评估中，每次搜索在线计算时间 1.92 秒，展示了 SEEK 的实用可行性与效率。
summary_cn: 加密关键词搜索协议 SEEK：密文分片+同态相关把长消息上传开销降两个数量级、相关计算快 5.47 倍，只泄露命中与否比特，原型每次搜索在线 1.92 秒。
objective_summary: 提出结合同态加密与两方计算的加密关键词搜索协议 SEEK，以最小充分重叠分片降低开销并隐藏除存在比特外的全部信息，配端到端原型实现评估。
evidence_note: 与最强分片基线的定量对比（开销降两个数量级、5.47 倍加速、大小写变体 100% 准确）+端到端 Web/移动原型实测（1.92 秒/次）；无第三方审计。
novelty_note: 「最小充分重叠分片+单陷门同态相关」的设计点对消息关键词搜索是新的效率机制；HE+2PC 组合与泄露隐藏目标承袭既有框架。
scope: 结论适用于两方模型下的端到端加密消息关键词检测；ASCII 大小写不敏感匹配，不覆盖模糊/语义匹配与多关键词复杂查询。
limitations: 仅支持存在性比特，不含匹配位置；1.92 秒在线延迟对大规模历史仍偏高；安全性依赖 2PC 与 HE 参数的正确实现。

title: AIJon: Automated Generation of Annotations for Fuzzing
abstract: Modern fuzzers use code coverage as feedback to guide their exploration which has proven to be an effective strategy for driving exploration. However, this strategy overlooks inputs that may be interesting to the target program even without uncovering new code paths. Fortunately, prior research has shown that annotations generated by human domain experts can provide additional feedback, guiding the fuzzer towards interesting parts of the program. In this paper, we replicate experiments presented in IJON and extend them to real-world vulnerability detection at scale. To mitigate the scalability challenge, imposed by the need for human domain expertise, we propose utilizing LLMs to automatically generate annotations. We demonstrate the applicability of LLMs for this purpose and observe that LLMs can generate annotations that perform comparably to human-generated annotations. Motivated by this finding, we design AIJON, a system that leverages LLMs to automatically generate IJON-style annotations. We evaluate AIJON on the Magma benchmark and surprisingly observe that annotation-based fuzzing does not perform strictly better than AFL++. We conduct several experiments to identify the cause of our results and identify key insights regarding the impact of annotations on fuzzing campaigns, including their effect on the energy distribution of the fuzzer. Notably, we observe that LLMs can generate annotations that achieve comparable results to human generated ones, thus opening the door for future research to perform further studies on the impact of annotations at scale.
title_cn: AIJon：模糊测试标注的自动化生成
abstract_cn: 现代模糊器用代码覆盖率作反馈引导探索，这被证明是驱动探索的有效策略。但该策略会忽略那些即使不开辟新代码路径也可能对目标程序有意思的输入。幸运的是，先前研究表明人类领域专家生成的标注能提供额外反馈，引导模糊器关注程序中有意思的部分。本文中，我们复现 IJON 呈现的实验并将其扩展到大规模真实漏洞检测。为缓解人类领域知识带来的可扩展性难题，我们提出用 LLM 自动生成标注。我们证明 LLM 胜任这一用途，并观察到 LLM 生成的标注可达到与人类标注相当的效果。受此启发，我们设计了 AIJON——利用 LLM 自动生成 IJON 式标注的系统。我们在 Magma 基准上评估 AIJON，并惊讶地发现基于标注的模糊测试并不严格优于 AFL++。我们做了多组实验以探究原因，并提炼出关于标注对模糊测试活动影响的关键洞见，包括其对模糊器能量分配的影响。值得注意的是，我们观察到 LLM 能生成与人类标注效果相当的标注，为未来更大规模研究标注的影响打开了大门。
summary_cn: 用 LLM 自动生成 IJON 式模糊测试标注，效果与人类专家标注相当；但 Magma 基准上标注模糊化并不严格优于 AFL++，并分析其对能量分配的影响。
objective_summary: 复现并扩展 IJON 实验，提出用 LLM 自动生成 IJON 式标注的系统 AIJON，在 Magma 基准上评估并归因标注模糊化未显著超越 AFL++ 的原因。
evidence_note: Magma 标准基准上的系统对比（AIJON vs AFL++ vs 人类标注），配多组归因实验（能量分配分析）；无统计检验与多次重复方差报告。
novelty_note: 「LLM 标注≈人类专家标注」是新的能力结果，而「标注模糊化不严格优于 AFL++」的负面结果对 IJON 路线具诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于 Magma 基准上的文件型目标与 IJON 式标注机制；对结构化目标、内核模糊与标注类型多样性未覆盖。
limitations: 负面结果限于 Magma 目标集与所选标注策略；LLM 标注成本与延迟未报告；标注质量的自动化度量缺失。

title: The Verifiable Action Card: Trustworthy Human-in-the-Loop Control for Secure Autonomous Agents
abstract: Agentic browsers can execute security-sensitive actions under a user's authenticated session, making indirect prompt injection and deceptive confirmation interfaces a direct threat to action integrity. Existing human-in-the-loop (HITL) safeguards are insufficient when the approval prompt itself can be influenced by untrusted page content or model-generated text. We present the \emph{Verifiable Action Card} (VAC), an architectural defence that reconstructs approval information from the ground-truth pending browser action and trusted intent provenance, renders it out-of-band in the trusted browser chrome, and binds approval to the exact action re-verified at dispatch. VAC combines provenance fencing, a ground-truth action descriptor, default-deny confirmation, provenance-aware risk gating, and execution binding. We implement VAC in a complete agentic browser and evaluate it on a 24-scenario benchmark covering confused-deputy attacks, Lies-in-the-Loop dialog forging, indirect prompt injection, adaptive action substitution, provenance evasion, and legitimate tasks. Across the evaluated LLMs, attack success without VAC ranges from $68\%$ to $100\%$, whereas VAC reduces attack success to $0\%$ on every model, with $78\%$ legitimate-task completion and a $0\%$ false-block rate. These results show that grounding approval in the action that will actually execute provides architectural protection against security failures that prompt-level defences and conventional HITL confirmation cannot reliably prevent.
