title_cn: 可验证动作卡：安全自主智能体的可信人机协同控制
abstract_cn: 智能体浏览器能在用户已认证会话下执行安全敏感动作，使间接提示注入与欺骗性确认界面成为动作完整性的直接威胁。当批准提示本身可被不可信页面内容或模型生成文本影响时，现有人机协同（HITL）保障并不充分。我们提出可验证动作卡（VAC），一种架构防御：从待执行浏览器动作的地面真值与可信意图溯源重建批准信息，在可信浏览器镶边中带外渲染，并把批准与在派发时重新校验的精确动作绑定。VAC 结合溯源围栏、地面真值动作描述符、默认拒绝确认、溯源感知风险门控与执行绑定。我们在完整的智能体浏览器中实现 VAC，并在覆盖混淆代理人攻击、Lies-in-the-Loop 对话伪造、间接提示注入、适应性动作替换、溯源规避与合法任务的 24 场景基准上评估。跨所评估的 LLM，无 VAC 时攻击成功率为 68%–100%，而 VAC 在每个模型上都把攻击成功率降到 0%，合法任务完成率 78%、误阻断率 0%。结果表明把批准锚定在真正将执行的动作上，提供了提示级防御与常规 HITL 确认无法可靠提供的架构性保护。
summary_cn: 智能体浏览器防御 VAC：从地面真值动作带外重建批准并与派发时重校验的动作绑定，24 场景上把 68–100% 攻击成功率降到 0%，误阻断 0%、合法任务完成 78%。
objective_summary: 提出并实现从地面真值动作重建批准信息、带外渲染并执行绑定的架构防御 VAC，在 24 场景基准上对多类攻击与合法任务做前后对比评估。
evidence_note: 完整实现+24 场景基准覆盖六类攻击与合法任务，跨多个 LLM 报告前后对比（68–100%→0%）；基准自建、无外部统计检验。
novelty_note: 「批准锚定地面真值动作+派发时重校验」是对 HITL 确认被污染问题的架构回应；溯源围栏、风险门控等组件有出处，组合与落地为新。
scope: 结论适用于带可信浏览器镶边的智能体浏览器场景；对无图形界面的后端智能体或攻击者控制浏览器的场景不适用。
limitations: 合法任务完成率 78% 意味着约两成任务受阻或失败；评估限于自建 24 场景；对更复杂的多步任务与自适应 UI 伪造未测。

title: Detecting Logic Vulnerabilities Across the Contract and Device Layers of Blockchain-Enabled IoT With Multi-Agent Heterogeneous Graph Attention
abstract: Blockchain-enabled Internet of Things (IoT) systems integrate smart contracts with embedded devices to support decentralized device management and access control. Their security therefore depends jointly on the logic of on-chain contracts and off-chain device firmware. Logic flaws in either layer can violate the same system invariants, such as unauthorized access, improper state changes, or unguarded privileged operations. Existing approaches rely on contract analysis, firmware analysis, and graph-based vulnerability detection. However, these methods typically focus on a single layer or artifact and often depend on predefined vulnerability patterns, emulation fidelity, or homogeneous representations that obscure security-relevant component roles. They also lack a unified architecture that supports different security tasks while remaining deployable on resource-constrained gateways. To address these limitations, we extend MA-HGAT into a cross-layer multi-agent heterogeneous graph attention framework that models contracts, firmware artifacts, device fleets, and transaction streams with a unified four-role, nine-relation schema. Role-aligned agents exchange heterogeneous evidence through cross-attention, while graph-, link-, and node-level heads support multiple detection tasks and a role-based gateway--cloud partition enables lightweight edge inference. MA-HGAT thus provides a unified and deployable framework for detecting logic vulnerabilities across the contract and device layers of blockchain-enabled IoT systems.
title_cn: 用多智能体异构图注意力检测区块链物联网合约层与设备层的逻辑漏洞
abstract_cn: 区块链赋能的物联网系统把智能合约与嵌入式设备集成起来，以支持去中心化的设备管理与访问控制。其安全性因此同时取决于链上合约与链下设备固件的逻辑。任一层的逻辑缺陷都可能违反同一系统不变量，例如未授权访问、不当状态变更或未受保护的特权操作。现有方法依赖合约分析、固件分析与基于图的漏洞检测，但通常只关注单一层或单一工件，且常依赖预定义漏洞模式、仿真保真度或掩盖安全相关组件角色的同质表示；也缺乏一个既支持不同安全任务又能在资源受限网关上部署的统一架构。为解决这些局限，我们把 MA-HGAT 扩展为跨层多智能体异构图注意力框架，以统一的四角色九关系模式建模合约、固件工件、设备群与交易流；角色对齐的智能体通过交叉注意力交换异构证据，图、链路与节点级头部支持多种检测任务，基于角色的网关-云分区支持轻量边缘推理。MA-HGAT 由此为检测区块链 IoT 系统合约层与设备层的逻辑漏洞提供统一且可部署的框架。
summary_cn: 跨层多智能体异构图注意力 MA-HGAT：四角色九关系统一建模合约+固件+设备群+交易流以检测区块链 IoT 逻辑漏洞，网关-云分区支持边缘部署。
objective_summary: 提出跨层多智能体异构图注意力框架 MA-HGAT，以统一模式建模合约、固件、设备群与交易流做逻辑漏洞检测，并设计网关-云分区支持边缘推理。
evidence_note: 摘要未报告任何量化检测结果或与基线的对比；架构设计与部署分区描述详细，实证支撑不明。
novelty_note: 把合约与设备固件纳入同一异构图模式做跨层漏洞检测是新的场景组合；多智能体+异构图注意力组件均有出处。

title: Autonomy in Check: Governor-Mediated Adaptive Security at the Edge
abstract: Adaptive security at the network edge increasingly relies on automated planners, including rule-based controllers, learned policies, and LLM-assisted agents, that translate observations into enforcement actions. Once such a planner can influence live policy state, syntactic validity is not enough. A semantically wrong action, produced from incomplete or manipulated observations, can be faithfully executed by an enforcement substrate that cannot judge mission context. We address this problem by treating the boundary between planner output and kernel enforcement input as the primary security object. We propose a split-control architecture in which an untrusted planner emits typed security intents, a deterministic governor checks each intent against safety, resource, temporal-stability, and proportionality invariants, and only admitted actions are bound to signed receipts and compiled into pre-installed eBPF map updates. The paper formalizes this trust-boundary problem, defines three threat classes, develops the governor admission predicate, and reports an end-to-end prototype. Across rule-based and LLM-assisted planners on a Raspberry Pi 5 testbed connected to the university 5G Test Network, the governor admits, rejects, and bounds intents at microsecond cost without disrupting protected-flow regularity. The contribution is conceptual as much as empirical: adaptive security does not need to trust the author of an action. It needs a mediation boundary that decides whether the action is admissible.
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures
title_cn: 自治有度：治理器中介的边缘自适应安全
abstract_cn: 网络边缘的自适应安全日益依赖自动规划器——包括基于规则的控制器、学习策略与 LLM 辅助智能体——把观测转译为执行动作。一旦这样的规划器能影响在线策略状态，语法正确就不够了：来自不完整或被操纵观测的语义错误动作，可能被无法判断任务语境的执行基底忠实执行。我们把规划器输出与内核执行输入之间的边界当作首要安全对象。我们提出分治控制架构：不可信规划器发出类型化安全意图，确定性治理器（governor）按安全、资源、时间稳定性与相称性不变量检查每个意图，只有获准的动作才被绑定签名回执并编译进预装的 eBPF map 更新。论文形式化这一信任边界问题，定义三类威胁，发展治理器准入谓词，并报告端到端原型。在接入大学 5G 测试网的 Raspberry Pi 5 测试台上，跨基于规则与 LLM 辅助的规划器，治理器以微秒级成本准入、拒绝并约束意图，且不干扰受保护流的规律性。贡献与其实证同样偏概念：自适应安全不需要信任动作的作者，而是需要一个决定动作是否可准入的中介边界。
summary_cn: 以确定性治理器中介不可信（含 LLM）规划器到 eBPF 内核执行的边界：RPi 5+5G 测试网上微秒级准入/拒绝/约束意图，「不信任动作作者、只设准入边界」。
objective_summary: 提出以确定性治理器中介不可信规划器输出与内核执行输入的分治控制架构，形式化信任边界与准入谓词并在 RPi 5/5G 测试台上做端到端原型评估。
evidence_note: Raspberry Pi 5+大学 5G 测试网上的端到端原型，跨规则与 LLM 两类规划器测量准入成本与流量规律性；恶意意图拦截率等对抗效果未系统报告。
novelty_note: 把「规划器输出-内核执行」边界确立为安全对象并给出类型化意图+准入谓词+签名回执的完整中介设计，切合自适应安全的 LLM 化趋势；策略中介思想本身有根源。
scope: 结论适用于具备 eBPF 执行基底与预装策略的边缘/5G 场景；对内核级漏洞、物理层攻击与跨设备协调攻击不适用。
limitations: 对抗评估有限，恶意意图样本与绕过尝试未系统报告；治理器不变量的完备性依赖人工定义；单节点测试台。

title: A GAN-Based Framework for Robust DDoS Attack Detection
abstract: The availability and consistency of online services remain vulnerable due to Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks. These attacks are evolving by adopting more complex strategies to evade traditional network security systems. Despite the effectiveness of machine learning models in detecting DDoS traffic, targeted adversarial attacks can degrade their classification accuracy. This work proposes a robust detection framework that integrates generative adversarial modelling with advanced machine learning models. We trained Random Forests, Deep Neural Ensembles, and Transformer-based models using the CICDDoS2019 dataset to establish the frameworks baseline performance. To enhance the models defensive capacity, we generated synthetic adversarial flows that simulate potential evasion attempts and adversarial traffic using a Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP). Then, we combined the generated traffic with benign and malicious traffic to construct hybrid datasets to train the models to learn more generalizable decision boundaries. The experimental results indicate that the proposed methodology significantly enhances detection accuracy and resilience, especially against unseen adversarial traffic. We also tested the designed framework using real-world generated traffic, which demonstrates its capability in practical settings. The scalable and efficient solution against adversarial DDoS attacks, introduced in this work, paves the way towards more resilient and adaptive network defense systems that combine generative adversarial augmentation with recent advances in learning models.
title_cn: 面向鲁棒 DDoS 攻击检测的 GAN 框架
abstract_cn: 在线服务的可用性与一致性仍易受分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击影响。这些攻击正采用更复杂的策略规避传统网络安全系统。尽管机器学习模型在检测 DDoS 流量上很有效，定向对抗攻击仍能降低其分类精度。这项工作提出一个集成生成对抗建模与先进机器学习模型的鲁棒检测框架。我们用 CICDDoS2019 数据集训练随机森林、深度神经网络集成与基于 Transformer 的模型以建立框架的基线性能。为增强模型的防御能力，我们用带梯度惩罚的 Wasserstein 生成对抗网络（WGAN-GP）生成模拟潜在规避尝试与对抗流量的合成对抗流；随后把生成的流量与良性和恶意流量合并构造混合数据集，训练模型学习更可泛化的决策边界。实验结果表明所提方法显著提升检测精度与韧性，尤其对未见对抗流量。我们还用真实生成的流量测试了所设计框架，证明其在实际场景中的能力。这项工作引入的可扩展、高效对抗 DDoS 攻击方案，为结合生成对抗增强与学习模型最新进展的更具韧性的自适应网络防御系统铺平道路。
summary_cn: 以 WGAN-GP 生成对抗流量增广 CICDDoS2019 训练 RF/DNN 集成/Transformer 检测器：混合数据集训练显著提升对未见对抗流量的检测韧性与精度。
objective_summary: 提出用 WGAN-GP 合成对抗流量增广训练数据的 DDoS 检测框架，在 CICDDoS2019 上对多模型家族做基线与增广后的鲁棒性对比。
evidence_note: 公开数据集 CICDDoS2019+多模型家族对比+合成对抗流增广消融，并附真实生成流量测试；无统计检验，与既有对抗训练基线的对比未报告。
novelty_note: GAN 增广提升对抗鲁棒性是成熟思路，迁移到 DDoS 流量检测属增量应用；WGAN-GP 与多种检测器的组合为工程化整合。
scope: 结论适用于 CICDDoS2019 类流量分布下的 DDoS 检测；对全新攻击家族与在线概念漂移场景未评估。
limitations: 对抗流量为生成器模拟而非真实规避攻击；数据集陈旧且分布偏置已知；鲁棒性提升对适应性对手未测试。

title: Witness Encryption via Prime-Order Generic Groups
abstract: We unconditionally construct witness encryption for NP in the classical generic-group model, using an ordinary cyclic group of prime order. For SAT instances of size $n$, the encryption algorithm runs in time poly$(n)$, and any satisfying assignment can be used to decrypt in poly$(n)$ time with correctness error $2^{-n^{\Omega(1)}}$. If no satisfying assignment exists, then every generic adversary making at most $n^{\Theta(\log n)}$ group queries has distinguishing advantage at most $n^{-\Theta(\log n)}$. Along the way, we prove the first superconstant-factor NP-hardness of approximation result for homogeneous MinRank under randomized polynomial-time reductions, achieving a logarithmic gap even when the rank-one witness has a Boolean right factor.
title_cn: 基于素数阶通用群的见证加密
abstract_cn: 我们在经典通用群模型下、使用素数阶普通循环群，无条件构造 NP 的见证加密。对规模 n 的 SAT 实例，加密算法运行时间 poly(n)，任何满足赋值都可用于 poly(n) 时间内解密，正确性误差 2^(-n^{Ω(1)})；若不存在满足赋值，则每个做至多 n^{Θ(log n)} 次群查询的通用对手，区分优势至多 n^(-Θ(log n))。在此过程中，我们证明同质 MinRank 在随机化多项式时间归约下的首个超常数因子 NP 难近似结果，即使秩一见证具有布尔右因子也达到对数间隙。
summary_cn: 在素数阶通用群模型下给出 NP 见证加密的无条件构造：n^{Θ(log n)} 次群查询的通用对手优势至多 n^(-Θ(log n))，附带同质 MinRank 的首个对数间隙难近似结果。
objective_summary: 在素数阶循环群的通用群模型下无条件构造 NP 见证加密并证明查询-优势界，同时证明同质 MinRank 的超常数因子 NP 难近似结果。
evidence_note: 无条件安全证明（不依赖计算假设）、解密完备性与显式查询界齐备；另证明同质 MinRank 的近似难度作为支撑性独立结果。
novelty_note: 见证加密此前依赖多线性映射或不可证实现假设；经典素数阶群中的无条件构造属路线性突破，MinRank 近似难度结果亦为首证。
scope: 安全性限于通用群模型中的通用对手；构造效率为理论多项式级，未给出具体参数与工程可用性。
limitations: 通用群模型是理想化模型，标准模型实例化仍开放；查询界给出的是指数级安全归约；实际部署效率未评估。

title: Who Audits Whom, on What Substrate, with What Evidence? An Independence-Graded Audit Protocol for Agentic AI
abstract: Agentic AI systems plan, invoke tools and act with limited supervision; they are now both the subject of audits and, increasingly, the auditor. Independence, the foundation of assurance,is still applied to them as a binary. We argue that it must be graded along three orthogonal axes: principal independence (who controls the auditor), substrate independence (an auditor sharing the auditee's foundation-model family, toolchain or guardrails fails with it) and evidence independence (whether evidence is attestable rather than self-reported). Each axis has precedent; the contribution is to grade all three on a single audit, aggregate them by the weakest link, and apply the same rubric when the auditor is itself an agent. We give the model a formal basis by transplanting the beta-factor model of common-cause failure from reliability engineering, a seven-step protocol whose outputs a third party can verify, a structural detectability analysis of a procurement-controls agent audited at three grades, and a Monte Carlo study of the model in which a conventional internal audit of an agent-a real audit team, a second agent, provider logsp-surfaces 5.9% of the faults it could in principle see and none at all in half the fault classes. We map the triple to the EU AI Act as amended, ISO/IEC 42006, UK public-sector risk-management guidance and audit-regulator practice.
comment: 19 pages
title_cn: 谁审计谁、在什么基底上、凭什么证据？面向智能体 AI 的独立性分级审计协议
abstract_cn: 智能体 AI 系统在有限监督下规划、调用工具并行动；它们如今既是审计对象，也日益成为审计者。独立性——保障（assurance）的基石——对它们仍被当作二值处理。我们主张它必须沿三个正交轴分级：委托人独立性（谁控制审计者）、基底独立性（与被审者共享基础模型家族、工具链或护栏的审计者会随之失效）与证据独立性（证据是可证明的而非自我报告的）。每个轴都有先例；贡献在于把三者同时在一次审计上分级、按最弱环节聚合，并在审计者本身是智能体时应用同一规则。我们通过移植可靠性工程中共因失效的 beta 因子模型为该模型提供形式基础，给出第三方可验证输出的七步协议、对一个采购控制智能体在三个等级下的结构可检测性分析，以及模型的蒙特卡洛研究：对智能体的一次常规内部审计（真实审计团队、第二个智能体、提供商日志）只能发现其原则上可见故障的 5.9%，且在一半故障类别中一无所见。我们将三元组映射到经修订的欧盟 AI 法案、ISO/IEC 42006、英国公共部门风险管理指南与审计监管机构实践。
summary_cn: 提出审计独立性三轴分级（委托人/基底/证据）并按最弱环节聚合：蒙特卡洛显示对智能体的常规内部审计仅发现 5.9% 原则可见故障，并映射到欧盟 AI 法案等规范。
objective_summary: 主张智能体审计独立性沿委托人/基底/证据三轴分级并按最弱环节聚合，移植 beta 因子共因失效模型给出七步协议，配蒙特卡洛研究与法规映射。
evidence_note: 理论框架+蒙特卡洛研究与单一采购智能体案例的三等级结构分析；无真实审计干预实验，模型参数为设定值。
novelty_note: 把可靠性工程的共因失效模型移植到智能体审计、三轴同时分级并按最弱环节聚合属新框架；各轴概念有先例（作者自陈）。
scope: 结论适用于智能体 AI 的审计与保障治理设计；对具体审计市场的激励结构与执行成本未量化。
limitations: 蒙特卡洛与案例分析为说明性而非实证测量；三轴评分的判定标准依赖评估者判断；监管映射随法规修订可能过时。

title: Measuring and Exploiting Implicit Trust in LLM Tool-Calling Pipelines
abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLMs to invoke external tools, but every tool interaction exposes the model to attacker-controlled text through multiple input channels (tool descriptions, tool results, sampling messages) that share a single context window without privilege separation. In this paper, we present a framework to measure the trust profile of an arbitrary LLM based on a variety of payload framings sent through different channels. Following this assessment, we devise cross-channel fragmentation attacks that distribute seemingly benign payloads across two or three channels; no individual channel carries a complete injection, yet the LLM compiles the fragments into credential exfiltration. We evaluated our attacks across 12 frontier models, three production clients, and six payloads, totalling over 15,000 trials. Our evaluation reveals that cross-channel attacks are an unexplored attack surface: models that fully resist single-channel injection (0% compliance) exfiltrate sensitive data at up to 100% under two-channel fragmentation (e.g., GPT-4o, Llama 70B, Composer 2, Haiku 4.5). We further demonstrate value-aligned exploitation, where a tool's stated purpose requires the data the attacker targets, and a sampling system prompt override that injects persistent instructions via VS Code's MCP implementation. Finally, we evaluated our attacks against seven third-party MCP security tools and three prompt-based defenses. All tools failed to detect fragmented payloads, and prompt defenses proved model-specific rather than universal.
title_cn: 度量和利用 LLM 工具调用管线中的隐式信任
abstract_cn: 模型上下文协议（MCP）让 LLM 能够调用外部工具，但每次工具交互都通过多个输入通道（工具描述、工具结果、采样消息）让模型暴露于攻击者控制的文本，而这些通道共享一个上下文窗口、没有特权分离。本文提出一个框架，通过经不同通道发送的多种载荷框架来度量任意 LLM 的信任剖面。在此评估基础上，我们设计跨通道分片攻击：把看似无害的载荷分散到两三个通道，任何单一通道都不携带完整注入，但 LLM 会把碎片组装成凭据外泄。我们在 12 个前沿模型、三个生产客户端和六种载荷上评估攻击，共计超过 15,000 次试验。评估揭示跨通道攻击是一片未探索的攻击面：完全抵抗单通道注入（0% 服从率）的模型，在双通道分片下以最高 100% 的比率外泄敏感数据（如 GPT-4o、Llama 70B、Composer 2、Haiku 4.5）。我们进一步展示价值对齐利用——工具的声明用途恰好需要攻击者瞄准的数据——以及一个通过 VS Code 的 MCP 实现注入持久指令的采样系统提示覆盖。最后，我们用七个第三方 MCP 安全工具与三个基于提示的防御评估攻击：所有工具都未能检测分片载荷，提示防御则证明是模型特异而非普适的。
summary_cn: 15,000+ 试验揭示 MCP 跨通道分片注入：单通道 0% 服从的模型在双通道分片下外泄率最高 100%（GPT-4o 等），七个 MCP 安全工具与提示防御均检测失败。
objective_summary: 提出度量 LLM 多通道信任剖面的框架与跨通道分片注入攻击，在 12 个模型、3 个生产客户端上大规模评估，并检验现有 MCP 安全工具与提示防御的失效。
evidence_note: 12 个前沿模型×3 个生产客户端×6 种载荷共 15,000+ 次试验的大规模受控评估，另对 7 个第三方安全工具与 3 个提示防御做系统检验；置信区间未报告。
novelty_note: 首次系统提出并量化「跨通道分片」这一未探索攻击面，附价值对齐利用与采样系统提示覆盖两个新变体；对安全工具生态的失效测量具诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于经 MCP 或类似多通道上下文协议的 LLM 工具调用管线；对具备跨通道完整性校验或特权分离架构的系统未评估。
limitations: 攻击依赖模型把跨通道碎片语义组装，对上下文隔离机制的有效性未测试；防御评估限于现有工具；不同客户端集成的差异未逐一归因。

title: ISIA-AF: Orchestrating Reproducible Attacks and Multi-Source Data Collection for OT Systems
abstract: Operational Technology (OT) environments require realistic, reproducible security datasets, yet existing approaches often lack automation, multi-source data capture, and sufficient documentation for reuse. This paper presents ISIA-AF, a modular attack framework for orchestrating reproducible attack execution and automated dataset generation on industrial systems. The framework coordinates distributed attack clients, records network traffic and operational data, ultimately leading to a multi-source dataset. We derive functional and non-functional requirements from prior work and stakeholder discussions, and realise the framework following a design science research approach. A case study on the ISIA testbed, comprising a real industrial system and a simulated process, demonstrates how the framework supports centralised control, low communication overhead, and flexible deployment across network segments. The result is a practical basis for generating extensible, multi-source OT security datasets for intrusion detection research.
comment: 8 pages, 1 Figure, 1 Table, submitted version to Euromicro Software Engineering and Advanced Applications (SEAA)
title_cn: ISIA-AF：面向 OT 系统可复现攻击编排与多源数据采集的框架
abstract_cn: 运营技术（OT）环境需要真实且可复现的安全数据集，而现有方法往往缺乏自动化、多源数据捕获与足够的复用文档。本文提出 ISIA-AF，一个模块化攻击框架，用于在工业系统上编排可复现的攻击执行与自动化数据集生成。该框架协调分布式攻击客户端，记录网络流量与运营数据，最终形成多源数据集。我们从既有工作与利益相关者讨论中推导功能与非功能需求，并遵循设计科学研究方法实现该框架。在由真实工业系统与模拟过程组成的 ISIA 测试台上的案例研究，展示了框架如何支持集中控制、低通信开销与跨网段的灵活部署。其结果为入侵检测研究生成可扩展、多源的 OT 安全数据集提供了实用基础。
summary_cn: 模块化 OT 攻击框架 ISIA-AF：集中编排分布式攻击客户端并自动生成网络+运营多源数据集，在真实工业系统+模拟过程的测试台上验证可行。
objective_summary: 按设计科学研究方法构建模块化 OT 攻击框架 ISIA-AF，编排分布式攻击客户端并自动生成多源安全数据集，在 ISIA 测试台做案例验证。
evidence_note: 设计科学研究方法+单一测试台（ISIA）案例研究，验证集中控制与低通信开销等可行性；无攻击效果与数据集质量的系统量化评估。
novelty_note: OT 攻击框架与测试台数据集生成已有多个先行工作（论文自陈从既有工作推导需求），增量在自动化编排与多源捕获的工程整合。
scope: 结论适用于 ISIA 测试台这类真实+模拟混合的工业环境；对其他工业协议、更大规模产线与攻击多样性未验证。
limitations: 案例研究限于单一测试台；数据集尚未对外发布与第三方复用评估；攻击类型覆盖度未报告。

title: Bridging the Opacity: Evidence-Backed Cross-Chain Transaction Correspondence Reconstruction Across Heterogeneous Blockchains
abstract: Cross-chain bridges enable interoperability, but they also break the transaction trails needed to trace illicit funds. Third-party investigators typically cannot access the source-to-destination mappings maintained by bridge backends, and our survey of 131 bridges finds that only 16.79% provide complete public tracking. Existing approaches depend on official APIs, EVM-specific assumptions, or fragile temporal heuristics, limiting their ability to trace transfers across heterogeneous ledgers. We present XSplicer, an evidence-driven system for reconstructing cross-chain transaction correspondence (xTCR) without privileged access to bridge backends. XSplicer derives unified semantic specifications from public protocol documentation and transaction examples, translates them into lightweight parsers and verifiers, and links source and destination transactions by prioritizing hard evidence and using soft clues only when necessary. We evaluate XSplicer on seven bridge protocols spanning EVM, Bitcoin, and Solana. XSplicer achieves 92.5% global recovery rate and up to 98.61% on individual protocols. Under adversarial noise, its hard-evidence verifier retains the correct match in 100% of tested cases, while soft-clue matching degrades as ambiguity increases. In two real-world case studies, XSplicer recovers more than 1,900 historical transaction pairs after Multichain ceased operations and identifies 754 illicit cross-chain transfers worth 105.6 million USD in the Bybit laundering incident. These results show that public protocol invariants can support practical cross-chain forensics without privileged bridge mappings.
title_cn: 弥合不透明性：跨异构区块链的证据驱动交易对应关系重建
abstract_cn: 跨链桥实现互操作，但也切断了追踪非法资金所需的交易链路。第三方调查者通常无法访问桥后端维护的源-目的映射；我们对 131 个桥的调查发现仅 16.79% 提供完整的公开追踪。现有方法依赖官方 API、EVM 专属假设或脆弱的时间启发式，限制了跨异构账本追踪转账的能力。我们提出 XSplicer，一个无需特权访问桥后端、以证据驱动重建跨链交易对应关系（xTCR）的系统。XSplicer 从公开协议文档与交易示例推导统一语义规范，将其翻译成轻量解析器与校验器，并按优先使用硬证据、必要时才用软线索的方式关联源与目的交易。我们在横跨 EVM、比特币与 Solana 的七个桥协议上评估 XSplicer：全局恢复率 92.5%，单个协议最高 98.61%；在对抗噪声下其硬证据校验器在 100% 的测试案例中保持正确匹配，而软线索匹配随模糊性上升而退化。在两个真实案例研究中，XSplicer 在 Multichain 停运后恢复超过 1,900 对历史交易，并在 Bybit 洗钱事件中识别出 754 笔价值 1.056 亿美元的非法跨链转账。这些结果表明公开协议不变量可以支撑实用的跨链取证，而无需特权桥映射。
summary_cn: 免特权访问的跨链取证系统 XSplicer：七个桥协议上全局恢复率 92.5%，实际恢复 Multichain 停运后 1,900+ 交易对、识别 Bybit 洗钱案 754 笔共 1.056 亿美元转账。
objective_summary: 提出免特权访问、证据驱动的跨链交易对应关系重建系统 XSplicer，从公开文档推导解析器并以硬证据优先匹配，在七个桥协议与两个真实案例上评估。
evidence_note: 七个真实桥协议（EVM/比特币/Solana）系统评估、92.5% 全局恢复率、对抗噪声实验、两个真实事件（Multichain、Bybit 1.056 亿美元）案例验证，另附 131 桥生态调查。
novelty_note: 以公开文档推导的解析器+硬证据优先匹配替代官方 API 与时间启发式，是跨链追踪的实用新路线；证据加权匹配的组件思想有出处。
scope: 结论适用于协议文档公开且语义可解析的桥协议；对无文档、闭源或语义模糊的桥，硬证据可能不足。
limitations: 软线索匹配在歧义增大时退化；对快照式/隐私桥的覆盖未验证；恢复率依赖协议文档的准确性与时效。

title: "Your Robot Was Trained on a Lie": Collision Mesh Poisoning Attacks on Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Learning-enabled robotic manipulation increasingly relies on robot simulators for policy training and evaluation before real-world deployment. Inside a simulator, a 3D asset contains two separate geometries: a visual mesh used for rendering and a collision mesh used for physical interaction. For computational efficiency, the collision mesh is deliberately a coarse approximation that need not have the same geometry as the visual mesh, a legitimate and pervasive discrepancy we call the Visual--Collision Gap (V--C Gap). We show that the V--C Gap opens a new and practical attack surface, and propose Collision Mesh Poisoning (CMP), the first poisoning attack against robotic manipulation delivered through the 3D asset supply chain. An attacker modifies only the collision mesh of a 3D asset, leaving the visual mesh and all other components unchanged. A policy trained and evaluated with the poisoned asset behaves normally throughout simulation, yet degrades, fails, or creates physical safety risks once deployed in the real world. Since current asset review practices cover malware, copyright, and format compliance, but not visual--collision consistency, poisoned assets can be distributed through legitimate supply chain channels. We evaluate several defenses and our results show that they are insufficient to defend against CMP, highlighting the need for new defenses.
title_cn: 「你的机器人被谎言训练」：机器人操作中的碰撞网格投毒攻击
abstract_cn: 基于学习的机器人操作在真实部署前日益依赖机器人模拟器做策略训练与评估。在模拟器内部，3D 资产包含两套独立几何：用于渲染的视觉网格与用于物理交互的碰撞网格。为计算效率，碰撞网格被有意做成粗糙近似，无需与视觉网格同几何——我们把这一合法且普遍的差异称为视觉-碰撞间隙（V-C Gap）。我们证明 V-C Gap 开启了一个新的实用攻击面，并提出碰撞网格投毒（CMP）：首个通过 3D 资产供应链投递、针对机器人操作的投毒攻击。攻击者只修改 3D 资产的碰撞网格，视觉网格与其他组件不变。用被投毒资产训练与评估的策略在模拟中表现正常，但部署到真实世界后退化、失败或造成物理安全风险。由于现行资产审核实践覆盖恶意软件、版权与格式合规而不覆盖视觉-碰撞一致性，被投毒资产可经由合法供应链渠道分发。我们评估了若干防御，结果显示它们不足以抵御 CMP，凸显新防御的必要性。
summary_cn: 首个经 3D 资产供应链的机器人操作投毒 CMP：只改碰撞网格即让策略模拟正常、实机失效，现有审核实践与防御均不足以拦截。
objective_summary: 提出利用视觉-碰撞网格间隙、经 3D 资产供应链投递的机器人操作投毒攻击 CMP，验证「模拟正常、实机失效」效果并评估现有防御的不足。
evidence_note: 在模拟中对策略演示攻击效果并评估多种防御的不足；攻击仅在仿真验证、未涉及真实机器人实验，防御对比细节有限。
novelty_note: 首次把 3D 资产供应链中的视觉-碰撞一致性缺口确立为攻击面，「模拟正常、实机失效」的威胁模型对模拟到现实管线是实质新的攻击路线。
scope: 结论适用于依赖模拟器训练/评估且使用粗化碰撞网格的学习型机器人操作管线；对不依赖 3D 资产供应链的攻击路径未涉及。
limitations: 攻击效果只在仿真中量化，真实机器人验证缺失；防御评估限于现有方案；对资产审核流程的绕过以论证为主。

title: PentestChain: A Cost-Aware, MCP-Orchestrated Framework for Automated Penetration Testing with Free-Tier LLMs
abstract: AI-driven penetration testing has been demonstrated with premium frontier models such as GPT-4, but the per-engagement token cost makes continuous, automated testing unaffordable for the smaller organisations that need it most. This paper presents PentestChain, a ten-phase automated penetration testing framework that couples a curated, deterministic exploit map with a cost-aware AI cascade-a local Ollama model (qwen2.5-7b) first, then free-tier OpenRouter and Cerebras, with a rule-based fallback that always produces output-and exposes the full pipeline through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with eleven tools. We make three contributions. First, we treat US-dollar cost per engagement as a measured, first-class evaluation metric and show that a 7B-parameter local model, kept off the critical path by a deterministic backbone, sustains end-to-end operation at zero measured paid-API cost. Second, we analyse the attack surface that an MCP-exposed offensive engine introduces, grounding a four-position threat model in the 2025 MCP incident record (the CVE-2025-6514 remote-code-execution flaw in mcp-remote, the postmark-mcp supply-chain backdoor, and the tool-poisoning-rug-pull-line-jumping class), and contribute four mitigations. Third, we specify a reproducible, containerised evalua-tion protocol aligned with the standardised testbeds now expected at top-tier venues-AutoPenBench, a Cybench subset, and the PentestGPT 182-sub-task benchmark-with multi-trial statistics (more than 10 trials per configuration, pass-at-k, non-parametric significance tests and effect sizes) and direct, same testbed reproduction of the PentestGPT and PentestAgent baselines rather than citation of their published numbers. title_cn: PentestChain：基于免费档 LLM 的成本感知 MCP 编排自动化渗透测试框架
abstract_cn: AI 驱动的渗透测试已用 GPT-4 等高端前沿模型得到验证，但每次任务的令牌成本让持续自动化测试对最需要它的小型组织而言难以负担。本文提出 PentestChain，一个十阶段自动化渗透测试框架：将精心策划的确定性利用图谱与成本感知的 AI 级联耦合——先本地 Ollama 模型（qwen2.5-7b），再免费档 OpenRouter 与 Cerebras，配以总能产出输出的规则回退——并通过带十一个工具的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器暴露完整流水线。我们有三项贡献。第一，我们把每次任务的美元成本当作实测的一等评估指标，并展示由确定性主干保持在关键路径之外的 7B 本地模型能以零实测付费 API 成本维持端到端运行。第二，我们分析 MCP 暴露的攻击引擎引入的攻击面，把四位置威胁模型锚定在 2025 年 MCP 事件记录上（mcp-remote 的 CVE-2025-6514 远程代码执行缺陷、postmark-mcp 供应链后门、以及工具投毒-卷款跑路-插队类），并贡献四项缓解措施。第三，我们规定了一个可复现的容器化评估协议，与顶级会议现在期望的标准化测试台对齐——AutoPenBench、Cybench 子集与 PentestGPT 182 子任务基准，配多试次统计（每配置超过 10 次试验、pass-at-k、非参数显著性检验与效应量）并在同一测试台上直接复现 PentestGPT 与 PentestAgent 基线而非引用其发表数字。在迄今测量的旧版目标上，该框架检测了 26 个服务，富化了 34 个 CVE，产出了……
summary_cn: MCP 编排的十阶段渗透测试框架 PentestChain：本地 qwen2.5-7b+免费档 LLM 级联实现零付费成本，配 MCP 四位置威胁模型与缓解，标准测试台多试次统计评估。
objective_summary: 构建以成本为一等指标的十阶段渗透测试框架，用本地/免费 LLM 级联与确定性主干实现零付费运行，并规定容器化的多试次标准测试台评估协议。
evidence_note: 评估协议规范：AutoPenBench、Cybench 子集、PentestGPT 182 子任务，每配置 >10 试次、pass-at-k、非参数检验与效应量、同台复现基线；但已报告结果规模有限且摘要未给成功率。
novelty_note: 级联降本、MCP 编排与确定性主干均为已有组件的工程组合；「成本为一等指标」与对 MCP 攻击面的威胁建模是务实增量。
scope: 结论适用于免费/本地模型预算下的自动化渗透测试场景与所列测试台；对高对抗的真实目标与最新防御环境未验证。
limitations: 已测量目标为旧版系统，结果规模有限；7B 本地模型能力上限未讨论；摘要中成功率数据缺失。

title: FoundAna: A GNN-assisted Foundation Model for Graph Anomaly Detection
abstract: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify graph structures (e.g., nodes, edges, or subgraphs) that deviate significantly from expected patterns, which supports critical applications in fraud detection, spam identification, network intrusion, etc. Despite the growing methods in the field, existing approaches follow a one-model-per-dataset paradigm, limiting their transferability across diverse real-world scenarios due to task heterogeneity, label scarcity, and domain variability. In this work, we introduce FoundAna, a GNN-assisted Foundation Model for Graph Anomaly Detection - the first foundation model framework designated for generalizable, cross-graph anomaly detection by combining GNNs and transformers. FoundAna integrates an anomaly detection-specific GNN component with a standard transformer encoder augmented by four complementary positional encodings, which enable the model to capture both local and global structural information. Specifically, the positional encoding enriched node representations are passed through attribute and adjacency decoders, and the reconstruction errors serve as the anomaly score. Extensive experiments on nine benchmark datasets spanning financial, social, and citation network domains demonstrate that FoundAna consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The code implementation and Supplementary materials are here: https://github.com/FoundAna331/FoundAna.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, and 5 tables
title_cn: FoundAna：GNN 辅助的图异常检测基础模型
abstract_cn: 图异常检测旨在识别显著偏离预期模式的图结构（如节点、边或子图），支撑欺诈检测、垃圾识别、网络入侵等关键应用。尽管方法不断增长，现有方法遵循「一个模型对应一个数据集」的范式，由于任务异质、标签稀缺与领域多变，跨多样真实场景的可迁移性受限。我们提出 FoundAna，一个 GNN 辅助的图异常检测基础模型——首个面向可泛化、跨图异常检测的基础模型框架，结合 GNN 与 Transformer。FoundAna 将异常检测专用的 GNN 组件与标准 Transformer 编码器结合，辅以四种互补的位置编码，使模型同时捕获局部与全局结构信息。具体地，经位置编码增强的节点表示送入属性与邻接解码器，重建误差作为异常分数。在覆盖金融、社交与引文网络领域的九个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FoundAna 持续超越最先进基线。代码实现与补充材料见 https://github.com/FoundAna331/FoundAna。
summary_cn: 图异常检测基础模型 FoundAna（GNN+Transformer+四重位置编码）：重建误差打分，在金融/社交/引文九个基准上持续超越 SOTA，代码已开源。
objective_summary: 提出结合异常检测专用 GNN 组件与 Transformer 编码器的图异常检测基础模型，用属性与邻接解码器的重建误差作为异常分数并在九个基准上评测。
evidence_note: 九个公开基准数据集（金融/社交/引文）与 SOTA 基线系统对比并持续占优，代码开源；但基准规模与统计检验未报告。
novelty_note: 「基础模型+异常检测」为正在成型的趋势，FoundAna 的 GNN 组件+位置编码组合属工程化整合；「首个图异常检测基础模型」的表述与并行工作并存。
scope: 结论适用于节点/边级图异常检测基准任务与所测九个数据集领域；对动态图、子图级异常与真实在野数据未评估。
limitations: 九个基准均为静态图公开数据集；重建误差打分对高度不平衡标签的敏感性未讨论；与同类图基础模型的直接对比未报告。

title: Improved lower bounds for decomposable randomized encoding
abstract: A decomposable randomized encoding (DRE) for a function $f$ allows $n$ parties, using shared randomness, to encode their individual inputs locally so that the collection of encodings reveals $f(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$ and nothing else. DREs are widely used in efficient multiparty computation. Their main complexity measure is size, the total bit length of the local encodings. Yet the optimal DRE size remains poorly understood even for the $n$-bit OR function. We prove the first superlinear lower bound for OR and, more generally, for every non-periodic symmetric function. Under an additional symmetry assumption, we prove a sharp $\Omega(n\log n)$ lower bound for OR, matching the classic construction of Feige, Kilian, and Naor (STOC 1994). We also prove the first $\Omega(n^2)$ lower bound on DRE size for non-explicit Boolean functions.
comment: 24 pages
title_cn: 可分解随机编码的改进下界
abstract_cn: 函数 f 的可分解随机编码（DRE）允许 n 个参与方使用共享随机性在本地编码各自的输入，使得编码集合只透露 f(x₁,…,xₙ) 而别无其他。DRE 广泛用于高效多方计算，其主要复杂度度量是尺寸——本地编码的总比特长度。然而最优 DRE 尺寸即使在 n 比特 OR 函数上也知之甚少。我们证明 OR 以及更一般地每个非周期对称函数的首个超线性下界；在附加对称性假设下，我们证明 OR 的尖锐 Ω(n log n) 下界，与 Feige、Kilian 与 Naor 的经典构造（STOC 1994）匹配。我们还对非显式布尔函数证明首个 Ω(n²) 的 DRE 尺寸下界。
summary_cn: 给出 DRE 尺寸首个超线性下界：OR 函数在对称性假设下达尖锐 Ω(n log n)、匹配 STOC 1994 经典构造，并对非显式布尔函数证明首个 Ω(n²) 下界。
objective_summary: 证明可分解随机编码尺寸的下界：非周期对称函数的首个超线性下界、OR 的 Ω(n log n) 匹配界与非显式函数的 Ω(n²) 下界。
evidence_note: 理论工作达到紧界：OR 的 Ω(n log n) 下界与已知最优构造精确匹配，非周期对称函数的超线性下界与非显式函数的 Ω(n²) 下界均为首个。
novelty_note: 推进了即使对 OR 函数也长期未决的最优 DRE 尺寸问题，给出首个超线性下界并匹配经典上界，属实质性理论突破。
scope: 结论适用于 n 方可分解随机编码的尺寸复杂度；对称性假设下的尖锐界限定于 OR 类函数，一般函数的最优尺寸仍开放。
limitations: 尖锐 Ω(n log n) 依赖附加对称性假设；Ω(n²) 下界仅对非显式函数成立；未给出显式函数的匹配界。

title: QuanText: Protecting Dataset-Level Secrets in Textual Data Sharing
abstract: Natural-language datasets support many downstream applications and research studies, but releasing text can reveal sensitive global properties of the underlying data source, such as the proportion of records associated with a particular gender, diagnosis, or political stance. Existing work has largely focused on property inference attacks that recover such global properties, while defenses for protecting these dataset-level secrets remain limited. Differential privacy, although effective for protecting individual records, provides only weak protection for aggregate properties. We propose Randomized Quantization for Text (QuanText), a training-free and large-language-model-agnostic data release mechanism that protects global secrets in textual datasets while preserving data utility. Given a dataset-level secret, such as the proportion of records with a particular diagnosis, and attributes whose utility should be preserved, such as topic and sentiment, QuanText perturbs both the secret distribution and the distributions of correlated attributes. It does so by constructing candidate release distributions over secret and non-secret attributes, randomly selecting a candidate sufficiently close to the private empirical distribution, and rewriting each private text sample to match the selected distribution using attribute-related snippets from the original text. QuanText is inspired by the Statistic Maximal Leakage (SML) framework, which bounds leakage about a secret function of a data distribution. Under idealized conditions, we show that QuanText satisfies an SML guarantee. Since these conditions may not hold exactly in practice, we also evaluate QuanText empirically on real-world datasets. Our results show that QuanText achieves a better empirical privacy-utility trade-off than competing data generation baselines.
title_cn: QuanText：文本数据共享中的数据集级机密保护
abstract_cn: 自然语言数据集支撑众多下游应用与研究，但发布文本可能暴露底层数据源的敏感全局属性，例如与特定性别、诊断或政治立场相关的记录占比。已有工作大多聚焦恢复此类全局属性的属性推断攻击，而保护数据集级机密的防御仍然有限。差分隐私虽能有效保护个体记录，对聚合属性却只能提供弱保护。我们提出 Randomized Quantization for Text（QuanText），一种免训练、与 LLM 无关的数据发布机制，在保持数据效用的同时保护文本数据集中的全局机密。给定数据集级机密（如特定诊断的记录占比）与需要保留效用的属性（如主题与情感），QuanText 同时扰动机密分布与相关属性的分布：在机密与非机密属性上构造候选发布分布，随机选取足够接近私有经验分布的候选，再利用原文本中与属性相关的片段改写每条私有文本样本以匹配所选分布。QuanText 受统计最大泄漏（SML）框架启发，该框架对数据分布某个机密函数的泄漏给出界。在理想化条件下，我们证明 QuanText 满足 SML 保证；由于实践中这些条件未必严格成立，我们还在真实数据集上经验评估 QuanText。结果显示 QuanText 取得比竞品数据生成基线更好的隐私-效用折中。
summary_cn: 免训练、LLM 无关的 QuanText：随机量化+文本改写扰动数据集级机密分布，理想化条件下有 SML 泄漏界，实证隐私-效用折中优于数据生成基线。
objective_summary: 提出免训练的数据发布机制 QuanText，通过随机量化候选分布并改写文本样本来保护数据集级全局机密，给出 SML 理论联系与实证对比。
evidence_note: 理想化条件下的 SML 证明+真实数据集上与数据生成基线的隐私-效用对比；但 SML 保证依赖理想化条件，实证对抗性攻击评估规模有限。
novelty_note: 把防御重心从个体记录转向数据集级全局机密是相对空白方向；随机量化+改写的机制设计与 SML 的联系为新，组件（改写、量化）本身已有。
scope: 结论适用于以分布比例形式表达的数据集级机密、且可用属性片段改写的文本数据；不保护个体记录级隐私，也不对抗任意机密函数。
limitations: SML 保证仅在理想化条件成立；改写质量依赖底层改写模型能力；对适应性属性推断攻击的鲁棒性未系统评估。

title: Demystifying Gate-Level Localization of RTL Trojans
abstract: Hardware Trojans are malicious modifications that compromise functionality or leak sensitive data. They pose a severe threat, particularly when inserted at the Register Transfer Level (RTL). After synthesis, these Trojans are often concealed by optimizations in gate-level netlists. Recent efforts, including the ICCAD 2025 contest, emphasize golden-chip-free detection using machine learning (ML) on labeled netlists. In this work, we show that RTL Trojans exhibit stable structural and signal-flow patterns post-synthesis, enabling effective detection through targeted heuristics rather than generic ML feature learning. We propose LoRD, a lightweight heuristic-based approach that exploits these distinctive subgraph signatures, achieving near-perfect detection and localization on the contest testcases. Com- pared to a transformer-based ML baseline and top five teams, LoRD achieves on-average a score of 2.957 (out of 3) for Trojan- implanted designs without the data and tuning overhead.
title_cn: 解密 RTL 木马的门级定位
abstract_cn: 硬件木马是危害功能或泄露敏感数据的恶意修改，在寄存器传输级（RTL）插入时威胁尤甚。综合之后，这些木马常被门级网表中的优化所掩盖。近期工作（包括 ICCAD 2025 竞赛）强调用机器学习在带标注网表上做无黄金芯片检测。在这项工作中，我们证明 RTL 木马在综合后表现出稳定的结构与信号流模式，使得有针对性的启发式方法（而非通用机器学习特征学习）即可实现有效检测。我们提出 LoRD，一种利用这些独特子图签名的轻量启发式方法，在竞赛测试用例上达到近乎完美的检测与定位。与基于 Transformer 的机器学习基线及前五名队伍相比，LoRD 在无数据与调参开销的情况下，对植入木马的设计平均得分 2.957（满分 3）。
summary_cn: 发现 RTL 木马综合后仍留有稳定子图签名：启发式 LoRD 无需训练即在 ICCAD 2025 竞赛用例上平均得 2.957/3，超过 Transformer 基线与前五名队伍。
objective_summary: 分析 RTL 木马综合后的结构残留模式，提出基于子图签名的轻量启发式 LoRD，在 ICCAD 2025 竞赛测试用例上做检测与定位对比。
evidence_note: 在 ICCAD 2025 竞赛测试用例上与 ML 基线及前五名队伍直接对比，检测与定位近乎完美（均分 2.957/3）；但评测限于竞赛用例集，无独立数据集与统计检验。
novelty_note: 反直觉的实证发现（RTL 木马签名经综合优化仍稳定可辨）支撑了比 ML 更简单有效的启发式，具诊断价值；检测问题本身已有大量工作。
scope: 结论适用于 ICCAD 2025 竞赛类 RTL 木马测试用例及类似插入风格的木马；对刻意规避这些签名模式的木马未验证。
limitations: 评估依赖竞赛标注用例，木马类型覆盖有限；启发式规则对新木马风格的泛化能力未知；未报告误报率细节。

title: Ghost-Filled Orders: Detecting and Testing Atomicity Violations in Non-Custodial Prediction Markets
abstract: Blockchain based prediction markets combine offchain order management with onchain settlement. This architecture supports user controlled custody, since users keep funds in wallets or smart contracts while submitting signed orders to an offchain order book. However, it creates an atomicity gap. An order may be valid when accepted or matched offchain, but become invalid before the corresponding onchain settlement transaction is executed. This behavior, often called ghost filled orders by the community, can cause trades that appear filled offchain to fail onchain. This paper studies this atomicity gap through a case study of Polymarket. We show how the delay between offchain order acceptance and onchain settlement allows adversaries to invalidate unfavorable orders after observing market outcomes or price movements. We then quantify the scale and financial impact of this behavior over a nine-month period from August 12, 2025, to May 22, 2026, using 1.8 million reverted transactions involving Polymarket official smart contracts. Our analysis separates attacker profit from market and user loss, and develops conservative measurement rules to avoid overclaiming impact. We further develop a methodology for testing other blockchain based prediction markets and apply it to three additional markets. We find that all three are vulnerable to the same class of attack, and that one design enables direct attacker profit. We have reported the findings to all three projects; one project had acknowledged the issue at the time of the study.
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures
title_cn: 幽灵成交订单：非托管预测市场中原子性违规的检测与测试
abstract_cn: 基于区块链的预测市场将链下订单管理与链上结算相结合。这一架构支持用户自托管：用户把资金保存在钱包或智能合约中，同时向链下订单簿提交签名订单。但它造成一个原子性缺口：订单在链下被接受或撮合时可能有效，却在对应的链上结算交易执行前失效。这种行为被社区称为「幽灵成交订单」（ghost filled orders），可能导致在链下看似成交的交易在链上失败。本文以 Polymarket 为案例研究这一原子性缺口。我们展示链下订单接受与链上结算之间的延迟如何让对手在观察市场结果或价格变动后作废于己不利的订单。随后，我们用 2025 年 8 月 12 日至 2026 年 5 月 22 日九个月内涉及 Polymarket 官方智能合约的 180 万笔被回滚交易，量化该行为的规模与财务影响；分析区分攻击者获利与市场及用户损失，并制定保守的测量规则以避免夸大影响。我们进一步发展出测试其他区块链预测市场的方法论，并应用于另外三个市场：三者均易受同类攻击，且其中一个设计使攻击者可直接获利。我们已向三个项目报告发现；截至研究时其中一个已确认该问题。
summary_cn: 以 Polymarket 为案例刻画链下撮合与链上结算间的原子性缺口：九个月 180 万笔回滚交易量化规模，另测三个市场同样可被利用，其一可使攻击者直接获利。
objective_summary: 以 Polymarket 为案例刻画非托管预测市场的原子性缺口，用九个月在野回滚交易量化其规模与财务影响，并发展跨市场测试方法论。
evidence_note: 九个月在野大数据（180 万笔回滚交易）量化攻击规模与财务影响，测量规则保守并区分攻击者获利与用户损失；方法论复测三个市场并完成责任披露。
novelty_note: 「幽灵成交」为社区已知现象；新在首次系统量化其规模与经济影响、给出可复用的跨市场测试方法论，并发现一种可直接获利的设计变体。
scope: 结论适用于链下撮合+链上结算架构的非托管预测市场（Polymarket 及三个受测市场）；不外推到纯链上撮合设计。
limitations: 保守测量规则可能低估真实影响；对手行为归因基于链上模式推断；修复方案未在论文中验证。

title: When AI Agents Meet MEV: Cross-Chain Arbitrage in the Agentic Economy
abstract: We study cross-chain arbitrage when autonomous AI agents, rather than humans or bots, are the searchers. We model agents as both arbitrage extractors and Maximal Extractable Value targets, derive the optimal trade size for a risk-averse agent under mean-variance utility with stochastic bridge delays, and formalize multi-chain path selection as a belief-weighted online learning problem whose belief estimates converge under a Robbins-Monro schedule. Using 23,000 Uniswap V3 swap events across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Base, we find that Ethereum-Arbitrum price gaps average 0.044% at 10-second resolution and Arbitrum--Base gaps average 0.013%, so $10,000 trades clear in 63% of L2-L2 windows via CCTP while L1-L2 routes require $50,000 or more for comparable viability. Our adaptive path-selection algorithm outperforms standard baselines by 11% on average, and moderate randomization cuts MEV exposure by over 50% with only modest profit loss.
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables; Accepted to the 7th International Conference on Mathematical Research for Blockchain Economy (MARBLE 2026)
title_cn: 当 AI 智能体遇上 MEV：智能体经济中的跨链套利
abstract_cn: 我们研究自主 AI 智能体（而非人类或机器人程序）充当搜索者时的跨链套利。我们把智能体同时建模为套利提取者与最大可提取价值（MEV）的标的：在带随机桥延迟的均值-方差效用下推导风险厌恶智能体的最优交易规模，并把多链路径选择形式化为信念加权的在线学习问题，其信念估计在 Robbins-Monro 调度下收敛。基于以太坊、Arbitrum 与 Base 上的 23,000 个 Uniswap V3 兑换事件，我们发现以太坊–Arbitrum 价差在 10 秒分辨率下平均 0.044%，Arbitrum–Base 平均 0.013%；因此 1 万美元的交易经 CCTP 在 63% 的 L2–L2 窗口内可成交，而 L1–L2 路线需要 5 万美元以上才有可比可行性。我们的自适应路径选择算法平均比标准基线多赚 11%，适度随机化能在仅有温和利润损失的情况下把 MEV 敞口削减 50% 以上。
summary_cn: 以 23,000 笔 Uniswap V3 跨链兑换实测：Ethereum–Arbitrum 价差均值 0.044%；自适应路径选择算法较基线多赚 11%，适度随机化使 MEV 敞口降逾 50%。
objective_summary: 把 AI 智能体同时建模为跨链套利者与 MEV 标的，推导最优交易规模与信念加权路径选择的形式化，并用三链 23,000 笔真实兑换事件做实证测量。
evidence_note: 基于 23,000 个真实 Uniswap V3 兑换事件的量化测量（三链、10 秒分辨率），算法与基线对比并报告 11% 提升；风险模型为自建，无统计检验与置信区间。
novelty_note: 把 AI 智能体同时作为套利者与 MEV 标的建模并给出可解形式化是该交叉方向较早的系统工作；所用的均值-方差效用与在线学习均为既有工具。
scope: 结论适用于以太坊/Arbitrum/Base 上的 Uniswap V3 跨链套利与 CCTP 桥场景；其他链、其他 AMM 与对手策略未覆盖。
limitations: 价差与成交统计限于观测窗口样本；风险厌恶效用与随机桥延迟为建模假设；MEV 敞口对自适应对手的博弈未推演。

title: Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception
abstract: Heterogeneous cooperative perception (CP) enables connected vehicles with diverse sensor setups to share spatial awareness via compact feature maps, where receivers reconcile these maps using learned translation modules for fusion and inference. Prior attacks against CP in a homogeneous setting reveal that the data exchange introduces a critical attack surface: a single malicious agent can transmit crafted features that erase real objects from a neighbor's fused scene. Yet, it is widely hypothesized that heterogeneity naturally defends against these attacks, as the attacker lacks knowledge of the victim's detector and the translation module scrambles adversarial gradients. We demonstrate that this protection is largely an illusion. Using a matched-objective harness to standardize the perturbation budget, objective, and forward path, we show that properly tuned iterative attacks close or reverse the apparent robustness gap. However, these optimization-based attacks require ground-truth labels and iterative backpropagation, meaning they do not represent a practical field threat running in real-time. To bridge this gap, we introduce HetPoison, a learned generator that crafts a removal perturbation in a single, label-free forward pass. HetPoison transfers across major heterogeneous designs without requiring access to the victim's detector, matching or exceeding the effectiveness of expensive optimizer-based attacks. Since heterogeneity itself is not a defense, we propose HetShield, a lightweight trust layer that validates the spatiotemporal consistency across features, recovering 83--95% of the accuracy degraded by attacks, outperforming prior art.
title_cn: 异构协同感知对抗鲁棒性研究
abstract_cn: 异构协同感知（CP）让配备不同传感器配置的联网车辆通过紧凑特征图共享空间感知，接收端用学习到的平移模块对齐特征再融合推理。此前针对同构 CP 的攻击揭示：数据交换引入关键攻击面——单个恶意智能体发送的精心构造特征可从邻居的融合场景中抹除真实物体。而广为接受的假设是异构性天然防御这类攻击：攻击者不了解受害者的检测器，平移模块会打乱对抗梯度。我们证明这种保护基本是幻觉。用统一扰动预算、目标与前向路径的匹配目标评测框架，我们表明恰当调优的迭代攻击可以缩小甚至逆转表观的鲁棒性差距。但这些基于优化的攻击需要真值标签与迭代反向传播，不代表实时在场的实际威胁。为此我们提出 HetPoison：一个学习式生成器，单次无标签前向传播即可产出抹除扰动。HetPoison 在不接触受害者检测器的情况下跨主要异构设计迁移，效果比肩甚至超过昂贵的优化攻击。既然异构性本身不是防御，我们进一步提出 HetShield——一个校验特征时空一致性的轻量信任层，可恢复攻击所致精度损失的 83–95%，优于既有工作。
summary_cn: 证伪「异构性天然防御协同感知攻击」：无标签单次前向的 HetPoison 跨异构设计迁移攻击，配套 HetShield 恢复 83–95% 精度损失，优于既有防御。
objective_summary: 用统一预算的评测框架检验异构协同感知的对抗鲁棒性假设，提出免标签单次前向的攻击生成器 HetPoison 与时空一致性信任层 HetShield。
evidence_note: 统一预算/目标的匹配评测框架、跨多种异构设计的迁移实验、与优化攻击及既有防御的系统对比并给出 83–95% 恢复率；数据集与统计检验细节未报告。
novelty_note: 首次系统证伪异构性防御假设，并提出免标签、单次前向、跨异构设计迁移的协同感知攻击 HetPoison 与配套信任层防御，攻击与防御双侧均有实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于基于特征交换的异构协同感知（车联网场景）；攻击假设攻击者可接入通信链路，防御评估限于特征级时空一致性校验。
limitations: 优化攻击需真值标签与迭代反传、不构成实时威胁；HetShield 只验证时空一致性，对物理一致的更隐蔽扰动未评估；实验数据自建。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Personalization in Conversational Cybersecurity Assistants
abstract: Users increasingly turn to Large Language Models to answer a variety of questions, including cybersecurity questions. We study how personalization strategies can help improve the effectiveness of answers to questions asked to an LLM-based cybersecurity assistant. Beyond accuracy, we focus on the understandability, actionability and, most importantly, motivating power of answers, given how often users fail to follow cybersecurity recommendations. Specifically, we investigate four personalization strategies, ranging from static user profiles to interaction-history-based personalization, using a corpus of 1,045 real-world cybersecurity questions and a 7-day deployment involving 57 participants and 1,066 user questions. Across both a large-scale automated LLM-based evaluation and human evaluation, conversation-based personalization is consistently favored in comparative ratings of perceived helpfulness and likelihood of following security advice. Importantly, the relative trends observed in the LLM-based evaluation align with those obtained from human evaluation, suggesting that LLM-based evaluation can provide a scalable mechanism for comparing personalization strategies before costly user studies. These results indicate that behavior-driven personalization is a promising direction for LLM-powered cybersecurity assistants and highlight the value of combining LLM-based and human evaluation when studying personalized language-model systems.
comment: Accepted as a poster at the HAIPS Workshop at COLM 2026
title_cn: 评估对话式网络安全助手中个性化的影响
abstract_cn: 用户越来越多地求助于大语言模型回答各种问题，包括网络安全问题。我们研究个性化策略如何帮助提升 LLM 网络安全助手回答的有效性。除准确性外，我们关注回答的可理解性、可执行性，以及最重要的激励力——因为用户经常不遵循网络安全建议。具体地，我们考察四种个性化策略，从静态用户画像到基于交互历史的个性化，使用包含 1,045 个真实网络安全问题的语料库和一次涉及 57 名参与者、1,066 个用户问题的 7 天部署。在大规模自动化 LLM 评估与人工评估中，基于对话的个性化在感知有用性与遵循安全建议的可能性等比较评分上始终更受青睐。重要的是，LLM 评估观察到的相对趋势与人工评估一致，表明 LLM 评估可以在耗资巨大的用户研究之前提供比较个性化策略的可扩展机制。这些结果表明行为驱动的个性化是 LLM 网络安全助手的一个有前景方向，并凸显了在研究个性化语言模型系统时结合 LLM 与人工评估的价值。
summary_cn: 57 人 7 天真实部署+1,045 问语料对比四种个性化策略：对话历史个性化在感知有用性与建议遵循意愿上一致最优，且 LLM 评估趋势与人工评估吻合。
objective_summary: 用 1,045 个真实安全问题语料与 7 天 57 人部署，比较四种个性化策略在可理解性、可执行性与激励力上的表现，并验证 LLM 评估与人工评估的趋势一致性。
evidence_note: 7 天真实部署（57 人、1,066 问）+大规模 LLM 评估+人工评估三方对照，比较评分一致；但为比较性偏好评分，样本量中等，COLM 2026 工作坊海报。
novelty_note: 个性化策略（静态画像、交互历史）均为已有技术，新在网络安全助手场景的系统比较与「LLM 评估可替代前期用户研究」的可扩展性发现。
scope: 结论适用于 LLM 网络安全问答助手的个性化设计；部署人群与场景有限，不外推到高风险安全运营环境。
limitations: 57 名参与者的 7 天部署规模有限；「遵循建议」测的是意愿而非实际行为改变；个性化带来的隐私影响未讨论。

title: Reflections on Trusting Trust, Revisited: Contaminating Self-Modifying AI Coding Agents with Poisoned Benchmarks
abstract: Thompson's "Reflections on Trusting Trust" showed that a compiler can be poisoned to reinsert its own backdoor, so that even recompiling clean source reproduces the Trojan. Today, substantial coding work is done by AI coding agents -- and increasingly, those agents generate new versions of themselves. We reconsider Thompson's attack when the "compiler" is a self-modifying coding agent. Can an adversary supply poisoned benchmarks to the agent's self-evaluation and self-improvement process to induce future versions of the agent to write vulnerable code on clean, held-out tasks? We instantiate this attack against three recently proposed self-modifying coding agents: the Darwin G\"odel Machine (with our experimental modifications), the Self-Improving Coding Agent, and Hyperagents (both substantively unmodified). We demonstrate successful proofs-of-concept: for example, with Hyperagents powered by Sonnet 4.5, our poisoned benchmark leads the agent to self-evolve instructions that disable HTTPS certificate validation on neutral URL-fetching tasks. From our experiments, we distill properties of the vulnerability, benchmark, model, and agent scaffolding that are sufficient to enable a benchmark poisoning attack. Moreover, we show that contamination often persists even when a poisoned agent is subsequently evolved against clean benchmarks. We discuss defensive directions and argue that self-modifying coding agents must be designed to be more resilient to such attacks.
title_cn: 对「信任的信任」的再反思：用被投毒基准污染自修改 AI 编码智能体
abstract_cn: Thompson 的《对信任的信任之反思》表明：编译器可以被投毒以重新插入自身后门，使得即使用干净源码重新编译也会复现木马。如今大量编码工作由 AI 编码智能体完成——而这些智能体越来越多地生成自身的新版本。当「编译器」是自修改编码智能体时，我们重新审视 Thompson 攻击：对手能否向智能体的自评估与自我改进过程投喂被投毒的基准，诱导其未来版本在干净的保留任务上写出带漏洞的代码？我们针对三个近期提出的自修改编码智能体实例化该攻击：Darwin Gödel Machine（含我们的实验性修改）、Self-Improving Coding Agent 与 Hyperagents（两者基本未修改）。我们展示了成功的概念验证：例如用 Sonnet 4.5 驱动的 Hyperagents，被投毒的基准会导致智能体自进化出在中性 URL 抓取任务上禁用 HTTPS 证书校验的指令。从实验中我们提炼出足以使基准投毒攻击成立的漏洞、基准、模型与智能体脚手架性质；并证明即使被投毒的智能体随后改用干净基准进化，污染也常常持续存在。我们讨论了防御方向，并主张自修改编码智能体必须被设计得对此类攻击更有韧性。
summary_cn: 向自修改编码智能体的自评估基准投毒可诱导其自进化出漏洞代码：在三个智能体（如 Hyperagents+Sonnet 4.5 禁用 HTTPS 校验）上验证，且改用干净基准后污染仍持续。
objective_summary: 针对三个自修改编码智能体实例化「投毒自评估基准以诱导自进化漏洞代码」的攻击，提炼攻击成立的充分性质并验证污染的持续性。
evidence_note: 在三个自修改编码智能体系统上完成攻击概念验证，提炼充分性质并验证污染在干净基准进化后仍持续；但以 PoC 与个案为主，重复规模未报告。
novelty_note: 把 Thompson「信任的信任」攻击迁移到自修改智能体的自我改进回路，开辟「基准投毒诱导自进化漏洞」的新威胁向量，并首次展示其可行性与持续性。
scope: 结论适用于带自评估/自我改进回路、外部可影响基准数据的编码智能体；对无自修改能力的常规编码助手不适用。
limitations: 概念验证规模有限且其一智能体需实验性修改；真实开发场景的触发条件与防御评估不足；防御方向仅停留在讨论。

title: Tight Lower Bounds for Differentially Private Continual Counting
abstract: The Binary Tree Mechanism is a standard algorithm for differentially private continual counting, but its asymptotic optimality under pure differential privacy has remained unresolved since its introduction. We resolve this question. For fixed $0 < \varepsilon \le 1$, we prove asymptotically tight lower bounds of $\Omega(\log^2 n)$ for worst-case expected $\ell_\infty$ error and $\Omega(\log^3 n)$ for mean and maximum per-coordinate expected squared error. These bounds hold for arbitrary mechanisms, even when the entire stream is available in advance. The same lower bounds hold under approximate differential privacy whenever $\delta\le n^{-c}$, for any fixed $c>0$. Our lower bounds match the Binary Tree Mechanism instantiated with Laplace noise, establishing its asymptotic optimality under both pure differential privacy and approximate differential privacy in the standard regime of $\delta \ll1/n$. Our proof uses a single hard distribution with a bounded exponential score on a tree. A simple modification of the score allows the same framework to establish tight lower bounds for all three error measures.
title_cn: 差分隐私持续计数的紧下界
abstract_cn: 二叉树机制是差分隐私持续计数的标准算法，但其在纯差分隐私下的渐近最优性自提出以来悬而未决。我们解决了这一问题。对固定的 0<ε≤1，我们证明了最坏情形期望 ℓ∞ 误差的 Ω(log²n) 与逐坐标平均及最大期望平方误差的 Ω(log³n) 的渐近紧下界；即使整个流事先可用，这些下界也对任意机制成立。当 δ≤n^(-c)（任意固定 c>0）时，同样的下界在近似差分隐私下也成立。这些下界与用拉普拉斯噪声实例化的二叉树机制匹配，确立了其在纯差分隐私与 δ≪1/n 的标准近似差分隐私机制下的渐近最优性。证明使用树上带界指数得分的单一困难分布；对得分做简单修改即可在同一框架下建立全部三种误差度量的紧下界。
summary_cn: 解决悬置问题：证明二叉树机制在纯/近似 DP 持续计数下渐近最优——ℓ∞ 误差 Ω(log²n)、平均/最大平方误差 Ω(log³n) 的紧下界对任意机制成立。
objective_summary: 证明差分隐私持续计数问题的误差下界，确立二叉树机制在纯差分隐私与标准近似差分隐私机制下的渐近最优性。
evidence_note: 理论工作达到紧界：单一困难分布统一给出三种误差度量的下界，上界由经典二叉树机制匹配，纯 DP 与 δ≪1/n 的近似 DP 均覆盖。
novelty_note: 解决了自二叉树机制提出以来悬而未决的渐近最优性问题，是该方向首个紧下界证明。
scope: 结论适用于持续计数问题的任意 DP 机制（含非在线机制），固定 0<ε≤1 与 δ≤n^(-c)；对 δ 较大或 ε 极小的机制未覆盖。
limitations: 下界为渐近意义（Ω 记号），常数未给出；限于持续计数函数，不直接推广到其他前缀查询。

title: Trust propagation and structural containment in Multi-agent LLM pipelines
abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly automate tasks involving agents with different levels of privilege, creating a security risk in which a compromised low-privilege agent can influence a higher-privilege agent and trigger an unauthorized action. We study attack propagation in a four-agent LangGraph pipeline comprising a Supervisor, Researcher, Validator, and Executor. We evaluate shared-memory poisoning and indirect prompt injection through a forged approval embedded in a retrieved document. We compare the Validator's judgment with an independent authorization layer using task-bound signed tokens and a separately verified policy oracle. Our contribution is an empirical study of attack propagation, a component-level ablation of the authorization boundary, and the Judgment Bypass Rate (JBR), which measures compromise at the attacked agent rather than at the final action. Across three seeds and 60 labeled tasks, memory poisoning reaches execution in every undefended trial. With authorization enabled, it achieves 100% JBR but 0% Unsafe Action Rate, showing that the Validator can remain compromised while execution is contained. Against an attacker possessing the signing secret, the policy oracle provides the observed containment, while an independently authored least privilege policy preserves this result. An Observer layer reduces the false-positive rate for agent hijacking from 49% to 7% without weakening execution-level security. These results show that structural authorization can contain compromised agent behavior even when upstream LLM judgment fails.
comment: Accepted at IEEE Cyber Awareness & Research Symposium (CARS), 2026
title_cn: 多智能体 LLM 流水线中的信任传播与结构性遏制
abstract_cn: 多智能体 LLM 系统日益自动化涉及不同权限智能体的任务，带来一种安全风险：被攻陷的低权限智能体可以影响更高权限的智能体并触发未授权动作。我们研究由 Supervisor、Researcher、Validator、Executor 组成的四智能体 LangGraph 流水线中的攻击传播。我们评估共享内存投毒与通过检索文档中伪造批准实现的间接提示注入，并将 Validator 的判断与使用任务绑定签名令牌和独立校验策略预言机的独立授权层进行对比。我们的贡献包括：攻击传播的实证研究、授权边界的组件级消融，以及在受攻击智能体而非最终动作处度量沦陷的「判断绕过率」（JBR）。跨三个种子与 60 个标注任务，内存投毒在所有未防御试验中都到达执行阶段。启用授权后，其 JBR 达 100% 但不安全动作率为 0%：Validator 可以仍然沦陷而执行被遏制。对持有签名密钥的攻击者，策略预言机提供了观察到的遏制，而独立编写的最小权限策略保持了这一结果。Observer 层把智能体劫持的误报率从 49% 降到 7%，且不削弱执行层安全性。这些结果表明，即便上游 LLM 判断失效，结构性授权也能遏制被攻陷智能体的行为。
summary_cn: 四智能体 LangGraph 流水线实证：内存投毒 100% 判断绕过但 0% 不安全动作，签名令牌+策略预言机实现执行遏制，Observer 层把误报从 49% 降到 7%。
objective_summary: 在四智能体 LangGraph 流水线中实证攻击传播，做授权边界组件级消融，提出在受攻击智能体处度量沦陷的 JBR 指标并验证结构性授权的遏制效果。
evidence_note: 3 个种子、60 个标注任务的受控消融，组件级对比（授权层、策略预言机、Observer），指标定义明确；但规模小、单一流水线实现，CARS 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 区分「判断沦陷」与「动作沦陷」的 JBR 度量并实证展示二者可分离是主要新意；结构性授权借鉴既有最小权限思路，组合到多智能体流水线场景。
scope: 结论适用于分层的多智能体 LLM 流水线（LangGraph 实现）；对更开放的多智能体拓扑与动态权限提升场景未评估。
limitations: 单一流水线与少量任务（60 个、3 种子）；攻击者模型限于文档注入与内存投毒；对适应性攻击者与更大规模流水线未测试。

title: State Without a Landlord: An Architecture Proposal for Peer-to-Peer Replication of Durable Workflow State
abstract: Durable-execution frameworks commonly journal execution steps of a long-running function and reconstruct state by deterministic replay; the journal is therefore the workflow's authoritative state, and in current deployments it typically resides with whichever provider hosts the run. This paper examines what changes if the journal is instead an authenticated, append-only log replicated among the parties to the workflow. We propose an architecture in which runs are chains of single-writer epoch cores; executor succession is governed by quorum-finalized closure certificates; durability, timeout, and checkpoint decisions are carried by explicit certificates rather than implicit trust; and large payloads travel a separate content-addressed distribution plane. A threat model separates what signatures establish (authorship and order) from what they do not (truth of recorded effects). We state the design as a set of typed artifacts and invariants, identify which claims are established by existing systems and which are proposals requiring validation, and define the prototype experiments, including specific adversarial cases, that would validate or falsify the proposal's central mechanisms.
comment: 51 pages, 8 figures
title_cn: 无房东的状态：持久工作流状态点对点复制的架构提案
abstract_cn: 持久执行框架通常将长时间运行函数的执行步骤记入日志，并通过确定性重放重建状态；因此日志就是工作流的权威状态，而在当前部署中它通常托管在运行所在的服务商处。本文考察如果日志改为在各参与方之间复制的带认证、只追加日志，会有什么变化。我们提出一种架构：运行是单写者 epoch 核心的链；执行者接替由法定人数终验的闭合证书治理；持久性、超时与检查点决策由显式证书而非隐式信任承载；大载荷走单独的内容寻址分发平面。威胁模型区分签名能确立什么（作者身份与顺序）与不能确立什么（所记录效果的真实性）。我们将设计表述为一组类型化工件与不变量，指明哪些主张由现有系统确立、哪些是需要验证的提案，并定义了——包括具体对抗案例在内——能验证或证伪该提案核心机制的原型实验。
summary_cn: 提出把持久执行日志改为参与方间复制的带认证只追加日志：单写者 epoch 链、证书化接替与内容寻址分发平面，并给出待验证的威胁模型与原型实验定义。
objective_summary: 提出以参与方间复制的认证只追加日志替代服务商托管的工作流状态架构，表述为类型化工件与不变量，并定义验证或证伪其核心机制的原型实验。
evidence_note: 纯架构提案：明确区分既有系统已确立的主张与待验证提案，定义了验证实验但未报告任何原型运行结果，无经验验证。
novelty_note: 把区块链式认证复制引入持久执行日志、以证书替代对托管服务商的信任，是对「工作流状态被服务商垄断」这一现实问题的新架构回应。
scope: 结论是设计层提案，适用于多参与方持久工作流；不涉及具体实现性能或与既有持久执行框架的实测对比。
limitations: 无原型实现与实验数据；证书治理的开销与法定人数可用性代价未量化；对抗案例仅停留在实验定义层面。

title: Physics-Constrained Digital Twins for Sensor Integrity in Urban Pedestrian Flow: Detecting Stealthy False Data Injection with Conformal Guarantees
abstract: City pedestrian counting systems now feed economic indicators, planning decisions and safety operations, yet the twins built on top of them treat the incoming stream as ground truth. We study what happens when it is not. We formalise stealthy false data injection for city-scale pedestrian sensing, where the map from latent flow to observation is far more rank deficient than in the power and water networks for which stealth has been characterised. Our twin estimates directed flows on the pedestrian street graph, assimilates counts through a learned graph-localised gain, and is trained against a flow conservation residual that couples metered and unmetered segments. Detection combines the innovation with that residual, and the alarm threshold is set by adaptive conformal calibration rather than by hand. To measure what the physics buys, we define the attack margin, the relative reduction in worst-case corruption of the estimated flow field, achieved against a white-box adversary that optimises directly through the twin. On six years of Melbourne data the margin reaches 0.54 against a single compromised device and falls to 0.19 when a third of the fleet is compromised, on a network where only 1.18 per cent of walkable segments are metered. Replacing the street graph by a distance graph collapses it to 0.09, which shows that the gain comes from the conservation law rather than from locality.
comment: 16 Pages, 4 Figures, 8 Tables
title_cn: 面向城市人流传感器完整性的物理约束数字孪生：带保形保证的隐蔽假数据注入检测
abstract_cn: 城市行人计数系统如今为经济指标、规划决策与安全运营提供数据，而构建在其上的数字孪生将输入流视为地面真值。我们研究当这一假设不成立时会发生什么。我们为城市级行人感知形式化「隐蔽假数据注入」：从潜在人流到观测的映射比隐蔽性概念最初出处的电力与水网远为亏秩。我们的孪生在行人街道图上估计定向流量，通过学习到的图局部增益同化计数，并以耦合计费与未计费路段的流量守恒残差为目标训练。检测将新息与该残差结合，报警阈值由自适应保形校准而非人工设定。为度量物理约束的收益，我们定义「攻击裕度」：针对直接对孪生进行优化的白盒对手，最坏情形估计流场污染的相对降幅。在墨尔本六年数据上，针对单台被攻陷设备裕度达 0.54；当三分之一设备被攻陷时降至 0.19——而该网络仅有 1.18% 的可步行路段被计费。把街道图换成距离图会使裕度塌缩到 0.09，说明收益来自守恒律而非局部性。
summary_cn: 在墨尔本六年数据上形式化城市行人感知的隐蔽假数据注入：物理孪生+保形校准对单台受陷设备攻击裕度 0.54，三分之一受陷降至 0.19，收益来自守恒律。
objective_summary: 形式化城市级行人感知中的隐蔽假数据注入威胁，提出物理约束数字孪生与自适应保形检测，并用白盒对手下的「攻击裕度」量化守恒约束的防御收益。
evidence_note: 墨尔本六年真实城市数据、白盒优化对手、消融实验（距离图使裕度从 0.54 塌缩到 0.09）证实守恒律作用；攻击为仿真注入、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把隐蔽 FDI 形式化到远更亏秩的行人感知场景，并将守恒残差与保形校准组合成检测器；组件均有出处，新在场景形式化与「攻击裕度」量化。
scope: 结论适用于计费覆盖率低（1.18%）、可施加流量守恒约束的城市行人计数网络；攻击模型为白盒、直接对孪生优化。
limitations: 三分之一设备被攻陷时裕度仅 0.19；依赖流量守恒假设与街道图结构；保形校准的误报预算与部署运维未报告。

title: Making AI-Assisted Claims Independently Challengeable: Publication Authority and a Protocol for Falsifiable Publication Records
abstract: AI-assisted claims can appear authoritative when evidence, analysis, human authorization, presentation, and correction history refer to different states. Provenance, attestation, and transparency expose history but alone do not specify the publication transition examined here. We develop Publication Authority as an exact-state, non-transferable, single-use publication capability and instantiate it in PAC-2026 (Publication-Accountability Calculus), a machine-readable AIJIM Protocol candidate. We evaluate its fourth bounded semantic freeze (SF-4), a fixed-profile specification designed for replaceable bindings. Six obligations govern evidence, runs and artifacts, measurement disclosure, authorization, surface correspondence, and lifecycle continuity. Each yields a target-bound witness, localized counterexample, or localized unverifiability; none can compensate for another. Only a fresh, complete all-pass record derives the permit consumed by one atomic publication transition. We use identity vectors, adversarial cases, finite models, and historical implementations. Ten models explored 110,764 safe reachable states; 76 unsafe configurations produced the expected violation or observer countermodel. A reader surface passing its correspondence check cannot authorize publication unless the accepted record admits that surface. SF-4 separates evidence horizon from verification time and rejects an authentic but causally invalid authorization. A historical predecessor path reproduced 17 frozen authorization-successor outcomes. A later in-house, instance-blind test of known case classes matched all 183 scored expectations; same-host package execution reproduced its 240 archived observations. Results support internal coherence, bounded safety, fault sensitivity, and limited constructibility, but not factual truth, general refinement, blind interoperability, field efficacy, or standards status.
comment: Main article: 24 pages, 4 figures; supplementary material: 13 pages. Preprint; not peer-reviewed. Yifei Dong is the corresponding author
title_cn: 让 AI 辅助论断可被独立质疑：发布权威与可证伪发布记录协议
abstract_cn: AI 辅助产出的论断在证据、分析、人工授权、呈现与更正历史指向不同状态时，可能显得很有权威性。溯源、证明与透明只暴露历史，但本身并未规定这里所考察的发布转换。我们提出「发布权威」（Publication Authority）——一种精确状态、不可转让、单次使用的发布能力——并将其实现为 PAC-2026（Publication-Accountability Calculus），一个可机器读取的 AIJIM 协议候选。我们评估其第四次有界语义冻结 SF-4：为可替换绑定而设计的固定剖面规范。六项义务分别约束证据、运行与工件、测量披露、授权、表面一致性与生命周期连续性；每项义务都会产生目标绑定的见证、局部反例或局部不可验证性，任何一项都无法补偿另一项。只有全新的、完整的全通过记录才能推导出被一次原子发布转换消费的许可。我们使用身份向量、对抗案例、有限模型与历史实现进行评估：十个模型探索了 110,764 个安全可达状态；76 个不安全配置产生了预期的违例或观察者反模型。通过对应性检查的读者表面，除非其接受的记录允许该表面，否则不能授权发布。SF-4 将证据视界与验证时间分离，并拒绝一个真实但因果无效的授权。一条历史前驱路径复现了 17 个冻结的授权—后继结果；随后一项内部、实例盲的已知案例类测试匹配了全部 183 个评分期望；同主机包执行复现了其 240 条存档观测。这些结果支持内部一致性、有界安全性、故障敏感性与有限可构造性，但不支持事实为真、一般精化、盲目互操作、领域有效性或标准化地位。
summary_cn: 提出不可转让、单次使用的「发布权威」并实现为 PAC-2026 协议：十模型探索 110,764 个状态、183 项实例盲期望全匹配，支持有界安全性而非事实为真。
objective_summary: 把「发布转换」形式化为精确状态、不可转让、单次使用的发布能力，给出六义务规范 PAC-2026/SF-4，并用有限模型探索、对抗案例与历史复现做规范内评估。
evidence_note: 有限模型探索 110,764 个安全状态、76 个不安全配置、183 项实例盲评分期望全匹配、240 条历史观测复现；但全部为自建规范与案例，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把发布授权形式化为不可转让的单次使用能力属新概念；评估限于规范内部一致性与历史复现，未触及真实出版流程。
scope: 结论适用于 PAC-2026 SF-4 规范定义的发布转换模型；不外推到事实真实性、标准地位或跨实现互操作。
limitations: 评估全部在自建规范与案例上进行（作者自陈为未经同行评审的预印本）；对真实出版生态的适用性未验证。

title: Intrinsic-Dimensional Wasserstein Guarantees for Private Synthetic Measures
abstract: We study an $\varepsilon$-differentially private synthetic measure for $n$ points in $[0,1]^d$ by applying the existing PrivTree algorithm to construct an adaptive binary partition and then privately releasing its leaf masses. We consider the worst-case data model without any sampling or population-distribution assumption. The 1-Wasserstein error of the synthetic measure is $\widetilde O_d((\varepsilon n)^{-1/d})$ for $d\ge2$, which is optimal compared to the minimax lower bound up to a logarithmic factor. Moreover, for $d\ge3$ and $2<s\le d$, if the data set has covering number at most $Ar^{-s}$ over the relevant finite range of scales $r$, the expected error improves to $\widetilde O_{d,s}((\varepsilon n)^{-1/s})$. Thus the rate depends on a finite-scale intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension, without requiring the recovery of a low-dimensional manifold. We also introduce a shifting technique to further avoid the exponential dependence of the constant on the ambient dimension $d$.
comment: 30 pages
title_cn: 私有合成测度的内蕴维数 Wasserstein 保证
abstract_cn: 我们研究对 [0,1]^d 中 n 个点构造 ε-差分隐私合成测度的问题：用现有 PrivTree 算法构造自适应二叉划分，再以隐私方式释放各叶节点的质量。我们考虑最坏情形数据模型，不做任何采样或总体分布假设。合成测度的 1-Wasserstein 误差为 Õ_d((εn)^(-1/d))（d≥2），与极小极大下界相比只差一个对数因子，因而最优。此外，对 d≥3 与 2<s≤d，若数据集在相关尺度范围 r 内的覆盖数至多为 Ar^(-s)，期望误差可改进为 Õ_{d,s}((εn)^(-1/s))。也就是说，误差率取决于有限尺度上的内蕴维数而非环境维数，且无需恢复低维流形。我们还引入一种平移（shifting）技术，进一步避免常数对环境维数 d 的指数依赖。
summary_cn: 证明 PrivTree 合成测度在最坏情形下 1-Wasserstein 误差 Õ((εn)^(-1/d)) 近乎最优，且数据具有有限尺度内蕴维数 s 时改进为 Õ((εn)^(-1/s))，无需流形假设。
objective_summary: 对 PrivTree 构造的 ε-差分隐私合成测度给出最坏情形 1-Wasserstein 误差上界，在有限尺度内蕴维数假设下给出更优速率，并引入降低维数依赖的平移技术。
evidence_note: 理论证明完整：上界与极小极大下界只差对数因子，覆盖数假设下给出改进速率，平移技术去除常数对维数的指数依赖，属达到近紧界的理论工作。
novelty_note: PrivTree 算法本身已有；新在证明误差率由有限尺度内蕴维数而非环境维数决定、无需流形恢复假设，是对已知算法的实质新分析与改进界。
scope: 结论适用于 [0,1]^d 上最坏情形数据的 ε-差分隐私合成测度，在覆盖数条件限定的尺度范围内成立；不涉及具体下游任务效用。
limitations: 上界与下界间仍差对数因子；改进速率依赖覆盖数假设在相关尺度上成立；理论结果未配实证效用评估。

title: You Shall Not Pass into Ring-0! A User Privacy-Friendly Anti-Cheat Architecture for Personal Computers
abstract: Kernel-level anti-cheats are effective against malicious player behavior in competitive video games, but raise significant user privacy concerns regarding installing unverifiable components at privileged modes (i.e., ring-0 in x86). While existing research has focused on improving the effectiveness of anti-cheats, the user privacy concern has been largely ignored. Tirith is an anti-cheat architecture that addresses this problem using two key ideas. First, instead of running video games within regular processes that players (as root admins) have control over, Tirith executes video games in Protected Virtual Machines that naturally sandbox computations from untrusted admins. Second, to monitor user behavior outside the sandbox (e.g., see if they are running malicious drivers), Tirith leverages a virtualization monitor that is trusted by both players and developers. Together, these ideas remove the need to run untrusted kernel-level anti-cheats, while providing the same level of protection compared to such solutions against a wide-range of common cheating mechanisms. The main challenge we face in implementing these ideas, however, is that the existing software stack for virtual machines is not designed to run video games and creates significant security and performance problems. We address these problems by proposing a security-focused Library OS kernel for games and an efficient graphics sharing pipeline for near-native rendering and display performance. In summary, without compromising on cheating behavior detection or performance, this work makes user privacy a first-class citizen in personal computers.
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. To appear in Proceedings of the 2026 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS '26), November 15-19, 2026, The Hague, Netherlands

title: SCHERI: Provably Secure Speculation Under the Constant-Time Policy for CHERI (Extended Version)
abstract: Capability-based architectures such as CHERI provide strong support for the architectural isolation of software components. To additionally protect against microarchitectural leakage, software can be written in a constant-time fashion. Modern processors, however, rely heavily on speculative execution, which can invalidate the constant-time guarantees and leak isolated secrets transiently. In this work, we show that providing secure speculation for CHERI is non-trivial, and that existing proposals fail to preserve the confidentiality guarantees. We develop a formal framework for reasoning jointly about capability safety, speculative execution, and information-flow security, and use it to demonstrate potential leaks. We then present SCHERI, a new processor design within this framework, and formally prove that it provides end-to-end secure speculation guarantees for the constant-time policy. Our results provide formal foundations and practical guidance for building future capability-based processors, which are resilient to Spectre attacks for constant-time programs.

title: Closing the Loop: Bidirectional Fully Encrypted Protocols
abstract: Fully encrypted protocols (FEPs) provide encrypted channels that make all protocol-generated bytes computationally indistinguishable from uniform random strings. Several previous works have explored security definitions and constructions of unidirectional FEPs: protocols in which one party acts only as a sender, and the other acts only as a receiver. However, most applications require two-way information exchange, and a network adversary can observe communication in both directions and their shared lifetime. Because the semantics of bidirectional channels involve more complex shared state, it is possible that the ``na\"ive'' composition of two unidirectional channels can result in a two-way protocol that can be detected based on dependencies between the two directions, such as traffic imbalance, channel closure, failures, or connection tear-down. To address this issue, we introduce new formal security definitions for bidirectional FEPs that capture exact shaping, delivery, protocol-state integrity, private half-close, and cross-direction isolation, while revealing a public ``sending schedule'' and ``closing epoch'' that may be randomized. We show that the trivial composition fails to meet these definitions, leading to practical detection attacks. We then construct provably secure bidirectional FEPs (BiFEPs) for both the datastream and datagram settings. For datastream, we combine two direction-separated FEPs with a ``wrapper'' layer that prevents detection based on the mismatch between uni- and bi-directional connection states. For datagram, we add encrypted DATA/FIN/ACK with replay protection and loss-tolerant close. We validate the design through a Rust implementation and show that none of the surveyed deployed protocols provides the full set of BiFEP security properties.

title: RobResilience: Implementing and Evaluating a Resilience Framework for Cyber-Physical Embodied Systems
abstract: In embodied cyber-physical systems, active cyberattacks pose an immediate threat not just to data, but to physical integrity and human safety. While existing security approaches excel at detection, they lack the runtime mechanisms to determine whether a disruption is tolerable or if performance degradation remains within safe operational bounds. This gap leaves autonomous systems vulnerable to graceful failure paralysis, where they cannot distinguish between a safe, degraded state and a catastrophic hazard during an ongoing attack. This paper presents RobResilience, an implementation of a formal resilience framework for embodied cyber-physical systems in a Webots simulation environment, using a PR2 robot and ROS2. The framework evaluates three predicates at runtime: tolerable disruption ($\delta$), tolerable degradation ($\gamma$), and mitigation feasibility ($\mu$), over a compromised device set derived from IDS confidence scores. When resilience is lost, the framework triggers available mitigation strategies. We evaluate our implementation through eight attack scenarios that systematically cover all possible combinations of the predicate state space, varying attack targets, degradation rates, and mitigation availability. Results confirm that the runtime behaviour of the implementation is consistent with the theoretical definitions.
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures. Published in Proceedings of the 2026 Workshop on CPS & IoT Security and Privacy (CPSIoTSec '26), co-located with ACM CCS 2026. Code: this https URL

title: Can We Stop The Ads? Taxonomy and Characterization of Smartphone Splash Ads and Existing Countermeasures
abstract: Splash ads are full-screen advertisements that pop up and appear as the first interaction page when users start an app, often tricking users into unknowingly activating certain trigger mechanisms, such as moving the phone to redirect users to other profit-driven third parties. So far, splash ads have already caused significant real-world impacts, ranging from significantly delaying emergency response to distracting drivers, as well as degrading accessibility of apps to vision-impaired users. We analyze 108 documented implementations of advertising defenses to examine their applicability to splash ads and the requirements users face when deploying them. Our analysis identifies substantial deployment barriers, including device rooting or jailbreaking, runtime code injection, and application modification. Options without these requirements can still involve additional permissions, rule maintenance, source compilation, or payment. In our evaluation of 13 configurations of 11 tools across 10 popular apps, only one tool prevented the target ad-triggered navigation across all ten apps. It required Accessibility permission, and ads remained visible for approximately one second before dismissal. Other tested configurations failed to prevent navigation or, in some cases, left host apps unable to launch or stuck on the ad page. We further analyze the outstanding challenges and pos- sible future directions, highlighting the urgent need to incentivize smartphone manufacturers to provide more friendly and regulated platforms.

title: GAUGE: A Formal Framework for Measuring Cryptographic Security under Heterogeneous Adversary Cost Models
abstract: Standards bodies report cryptographic security as a single number of bits, but this value depends on the adversary cost model used to price time, memory, and quantum resources. Different conventions can therefore produce different rankings of cryptographic schemes. GAUGE represents security as a function over admissible cost models, called a security profile. Comparisons then become comparisons between profiles, and ranking reversals become an explicit structural property rather than a measurement error. We formalize price functionals over a cone of adversary cost models, show that security profiles are piecewise-linear and concave, and prove a rating trilemma: when two profiles cross, no rating can simultaneously be faithful to underlying costs, total over comparable pairs, and independent of the chosen cost model. We provide a polynomial-time linear-programming procedure that certifies whether the ranking of two schemes is robust, reverses under admissible models, or is genuinely incomparable. We extend GAUGE with a two-layer risk measure combining stochastic cryptanalytic decay with uncertainty over the appropriate cost model. We evaluate the framework on NIST post-quantum standards, classical anchors, and a 25-year chronology of cryptanalytic breaks. The analysis certifies a ranking reversal for ML-KEM-512 versus AES-128 from a 4-5% shift in memory pricing, and measures a lattice-sieving cost drift of 9.79 bits per year over eight years. A hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 handshake reduces combined-break probability twenty-fold at a 2.3 kilobyte cost. The artifact reproduces all tables and figures in under seven seconds. GAUGE provides an explicit and auditable framework for reporting cryptographic security under competing cost models.
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures

title: SEMA-GUARD: Semantic and Graph-Based Vulnerability Detection in Assembly Code
abstract: In cases where source code is not available, such as malware analysis, firmware analysis, and embedded systems analysis, vulnerability detection in compiled programs has gained importance. Current methods are heavily reliant on syntactical regularities or higher level representations that are vulnerable to changes in the compiler and may not be readily applicable to assembly code.In this article, we present SEMA-GUARD, a framework that uses semantic analysis and graph neural networks to identify flaws in assembly code. The approach improves the representation of control flow graphs by adding information about the program's execution at a lower level of abstraction, including stack manipulations, memory accesses, and data flow. A set based on the Juliet Test Suite was used to evaluate the effectiveness of SEMA-GUARD. In this set, each piece of source code is initially translated into assembly language and then broken down into function-level chunks. The suggested method, which relies only on statistical or structural data, achieves an accuracy of 85.1\% and an F1 score of 0.801, according to the results. Such results imply that including semantic information in graph-based models may be a successful method for identifying vulnerabilities in compiled code.

title: Cross-Domain Inference for Human Localization: Applying Wi-Fi RSSI Data to CSI-Trained Models
abstract: Wi-Fi signal data can be used to compromise the privacy of individuals. While many existing approaches rely on Channel State Information (CSI), collecting this data on typical IoT devices often requires elevated operating system permissions and specialized drivers. Consequently, this paper investigates the feasibility of utilizing Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) data to predict human locations. RSSI was selected because it is accessible even on devices with limited user permissions, and therefore is more applicable to a wider array of IoT devices. To bypass the tedious process of obtaining training data needed to train an RSSI-based model, an existing Wi-Fi pose prediction project was used in this research. However, that project assumed CSI data as input. Therefore, we investigate the feasibility of cross-domain inference, i.e., feeding RSSI data into that existing CSI-based model. We collected an RSSI dataset, synchronized with video ground-truth of a person moving within a room, to evaluate the model's performance. This evaluation confirmed that RSSI data can predict locations with approximately 80% confidence when human movement is present. This demonstrates that a model trained on CSI data can be used to evaluate low-granularity RSSI data consisting of decibel-milliwatt (dBm) values to roughly locate people in the collection space. These results imply that a wide range of IoT devices can be used for privacy invasion in Wi-Fi-dense environments.

title: Plug 'n' Pray: Agentic LLM-based Detection of Potential Log File Exposures in Third-Party Content Management System Plugins
abstract: Content Management Systems (CMS), such as WordPress, power a large share of the web (~58%), and their extensibility through third-party plugins is a major source of their popularity as well as of their attack surface. One high-impact weakness that remains understudied is log file exposure by CMS plugins, which create log files for debugging or other purposes. If these files are insufficiently secured, they can disclose sensitive information (e.g. credentials, personal data) which has led to website compromises in the past. In this work, we present an agentic, LLM-based framework that automatically detects potential log file exposures in plugins of the most popular CMS (WordPress). Our agent analyzes each plugin by performing static and dynamic analysis. We evaluated our approach on the 300 most-installed WordPress plugins (about 0.6% of all), which together account for over 250M active installations, i.e. 75% of all active installations in the official plugin ecosystem. We manually validated each finding, reproducing 79 of 81 findings from 62 plugins. We observed that several protective measures appear to be implemented that we classify as creation-control (e.g. manual log activation) and access-control (e.g. deny rules in .htaccess). However, we find that multi-layered protection is required, but not always present. From these results we derive a taxonomy of log file path and protection patterns and deduce a set of best practices for developers to securely handle them. Finally, our study corroborates that agentic LLMs are an useful tool for security analysis.
comment: To be presented and published at 19 th ACM Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISEC'26) colocated with ACM CCS 2026

title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Workflows
abstract: We present a claim-relative evidence/reference framework for hybrid quantum-classical workflow integrity. Observational indistinguishability yields structural blind regions, distinct from finite-batch statistical misses. Within the declared lattice, a trusted same-batch scalar $R_0$ suffices for conclusion integrity, aggregate $M_0$ for aggregate plus conclusion integrity, and item-aligned binding for item identity. In 3,600 label interventions, feature/prediction views realize exact label-path invariance; all 764 geometry-aligned aggregate-blind rows equal their paired-clean responses, giving zero attack-only increment. For statistical response, the geometry-aligned construction detects 343/2,700 conclusion-changing ($\tau \to 0^+$) label interventions with the conformal rule and 1,183/2,700 with the uncorrected union; the original frozen same-item geometry yields 11/2,617 and 43/2,617, respectively. The executed conformal clean false-action rates are 0.048--0.059 descriptively; its finite-sample guarantee requires exchangeability, which the overlapping-draw design violates. The cluster-preserving adaptive stress test (Gate A) reduces response versus matched controls in 25--40 of 40 environment/split cells while retaining conclusion changes. A bounded 165-design-cell ideal-statevector and finite-shot-emulation branch directly instantiates semantic, estimated and observed kernel transitions. The fixed equal-weight design estimates neither deployment prevalence nor QPU, provider or deployed-service assurance.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary material (20 pages) is available as an ancillary file. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing (TDSC). Reproducibility artifact: this https URL

title: TasmScan: Continuation-Aware Taint Analysis for TVM Bytecode with Savelist Abstraction
abstract: The Open Network (TON), with a peak market capitalization exceeding $20 billion and over 175 million activated on-chain addresses, relies on the TVM (TON Virtual Machine) to execute smart contracts.
